sentences.zh: 選舉二

translations.literal: Selection and Appointment, Part Two
translations.idiomatic: Selection and Appointment, Part Two

sentences.zh: 〈（科目下舉遺逸附）〉

translations.literal: (Appended: Recommendations by Examination Subject and Unattached Worthies)
translations.idiomatic: (Appended: Recommendations by Examination Subject and Unattached Worthies)

sentences.zh: 高宗建炎初，駐蹕揚州，時方用武，念士人不能至行在，下詔：「諸道提刑司選官即轉運置司州、軍引試，使副或判官一人董之。

translations.literal: At the beginning of the Jianyan era, Emperor Gaozong encamped at Yangzhou. War was then in progress, and mindful that scholars could not reach the temporary court, he issued an edict: "In each circuit the judicial intendant commission shall select an official to conduct examinations at once at the transport commission's seat in each prefecture and army command, with one vice commissioner or administrative aide to supervise.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Jianyan reign, Emperor Gaozong took up residence at Yangzhou. With war underway, he worried that scholars could not reach the mobile court and issued an edict: "each circuit's judicial intendant commission was to choose officials to hold examinations promptly at the transport commission seats in the various prefectures and army commands, with a vice commissioner or administrative aide supervising each site.

sentences.zh: 河東路附京西轉運司。

translations.literal: The Hedong Circuit was attached to the Capital West transport commission.
translations.idiomatic: The Hedong Circuit was placed under the Capital West transport commission.

sentences.zh: 國子監、開封府人就試於留守司，命御史一人董之。

translations.literal: Students of the Directorate of Education and candidates from Kaifeng Prefecture were to sit for examination at the Pacification Commission, with one censor appointed to supervise.
translations.idiomatic: Students of the Directorate of Education and candidates from Kaifeng Prefecture were to take their examinations at the Pacification Commission, under the supervision of a censor.

sentences.zh: 國子監人願就本路試者聽。」

translations.literal: Directorate students who wished to take the examination in their home circuit were permitted to do so."
translations.idiomatic: Directorate students who preferred to sit for the examination in their home circuit were allowed to do so."

sentences.zh: 二年，定詩賦、經義取士，第一場詩賦各一首，習經義者本經義三道，《語》、《孟》義各一道；

translations.literal: In the second year the selection of candidates by poetry-rhapsody and classic elucidation was fixed: in the first session one poem and one rhapsody each; for those studying classic elucidation, three questions on their base classic and one each on the Analects and Mencius;
translations.idiomatic: In the second year the court fixed recruitment through both the poetry-rhapsody and classic-elucidation tracks. The first session required one poem and one rhapsody; candidates in classic elucidation faced three questions on their principal classic and one each on the Analects and Mencius;

sentences.zh: 第二場並論一道；

translations.literal: in the second session one discourse essay;
translations.idiomatic: the second session required one discourse essay;

sentences.zh: 第三場並策三道。

translations.literal: in the third session three policy questions.
translations.idiomatic: and the third session three policy questions.

sentences.zh: 殿試策如之。

translations.literal: The palace examination policy questions followed the same rule.
translations.idiomatic: The palace examination used the same policy-question format.

sentences.zh: 自紹聖後，舉人不習詩賦，至是始復，遂除《政和令》命官私相傳習詩賦之禁。

translations.literal: Since the Shaosheng era candidates had not studied poetry and rhapsody; only now was it restored, and the prohibition in the Zhenghe statutes on officials and private persons transmitting and studying poetry and rhapsody was removed.
translations.idiomatic: Since the Shaosheng era candidates had neglected poetry and rhapsody; only now was that curriculum restored, and the Zhenghe statute forbidding officials and private persons to teach or study poetry and rhapsody was repealed.

sentences.zh: 又詔：「下第進士，年四十以上六舉經禦試、八舉經省試，五十以上四舉經禦試、五舉經省試者，河北、河東、陝西特各減一舉；

translations.literal: Another edict stated: "Failed jinshi candidates aged forty or above who have presented themselves six times at the palace examination and eight times at the metropolitan examination, or aged fifty or above who have presented themselves four times at the palace examination and five times at the metropolitan examination—in Hebei, Hedong, and Shaanxi one presentation is specially reduced in each case;
translations.idiomatic: Another edict provided: "failed jinshi candidates aged forty or more who had sat six palace examinations and eight metropolitan examinations, or aged fifty or more who had sat four palace and five metropolitan examinations, might qualify with one fewer attempt in Hebei, Hedong, and Shaanxi;

sentences.zh: 元符以前到省，兩舉者不限年，一舉年五十五已上者；

translations.literal: those who reached the metropolitan examination before the Yuanfu era, with two presentations without age limit, or with one presentation aged fifty-five or above;
translations.idiomatic: those who had reached the metropolitan examination before the Yuanfu era with two attempts, without age limit, or with one attempt at age fifty-five or above;

sentences.zh: 諸道轉運司、開封府悉以名聞，許直赴廷試。」

translations.literal: all circuit transport commissions and Kaifeng Prefecture shall report their names, and they are permitted to proceed directly to the court examination."
translations.idiomatic: all circuit transport commissions and Kaifeng Prefecture were to report their names, and they were permitted to proceed directly to the court examination."

sentences.zh: 是秋，四方士集行在，帝親策於集英殿，第為五等，賜正奏名李易以下四百五十一人進士及第、進士出身、同學究出身、同出身。

translations.literal: That autumn scholars from all quarters gathered at the temporary court. The emperor personally examined them in the Hall for Assembling Excellence, ranked them in five grades, and granted to the four hundred fifty-one regular listed candidates from Li Yi downward the titles jinshi with honors, jinshi by origin, fellow student-scholar by origin, and fellow by origin.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn scholars from every region gathered at the mobile court. The emperor examined them personally in the Hall for Assembling Excellence, divided them into five grades, and conferred upon the four hundred fifty-one regular listed candidates from Li Yi downward the ranks of jinshi with honors, jinshi by origin, fellow student-scholar by origin, and fellow by origin.

sentences.zh: 第一人為左宣教郎，第二、第三人左宣義郎，第四、第五人左儒林郎。

translations.literal: The first place received Left Instructor in Instruction; the second and third Left Instructor in Righteousness; the fourth and fifth Left Forest of Scholars.
translations.idiomatic: The top candidate received the rank of Left Instructor in Instruction; the second and third received Left Instructor in Righteousness; the fourth and fifth received Left Forest of Scholars.

sentences.zh: 第一甲第六名以下並左文林郎，第二甲並左從事郎，第三甲以下並左迪功郎。

translations.literal: From the sixth place in the first class downward all received Left Literary Forest; the second class all Left Attendant Official; the third class and below all Left Merit Officer.
translations.idiomatic: From sixth place in the first class downward, all received Left Literary Forest; the entire second class received Left Attendant Official; the third class and below all received Left Merit Officer.

sentences.zh: 特奏名第一人附第二甲，賜進士及第，第二、第三人賜同進士出身，餘賜同學究出身。

translations.literal: The first special listed candidate was attached to the second class and granted jinshi with honors; the second and third were granted fellow jinshi by origin; the rest were granted fellow student-scholar by origin.
translations.idiomatic: The leading special-listed candidate was placed in the second class and granted jinshi with honors; the second and third received fellow jinshi by origin; the remainder received fellow student-scholar by origin.

sentences.zh: 登仕郎、京府助教、上下州文學、諸州助教入五等者，亦與調官。

translations.literal: Those entering the fifth grade as Court Gentleman, capital prefecture assistant instructor, literary scholar of upper and lower prefectures, and prefectural assistant instructors were also granted official appointments.
translations.idiomatic: Those placed in the fifth grade as Court Gentleman, capital-prefecture assistant instructors, literary scholars of upper and lower prefectures, and prefectural assistant instructors were also given official appointments.

sentences.zh: 川、陝、河北、京東正奏名不赴者一百三人，以龍飛特恩，即家賜第。

translations.literal: One hundred three regular listed candidates from Sichuan, Shaanxi, Hebei, and the Eastern Capital circuits who did not attend were, by the special grace of the Dragon's Ascent, granted degrees at home.
translations.idiomatic: One hundred three regular listed candidates from Sichuan, Shaanxi, Hebei, and the Eastern Capital circuits who failed to attend received degrees at home under the special grace marking the emperor's accession.

sentences.zh: 故事，廷試上十名，內侍先以卷奏定高下。

translations.literal: By precedent, for the top ten in the court examination the palace attendants first submitted the papers to fix the ranking.
translations.idiomatic: By precedent, for the top ten court-examination candidates palace attendants submitted the papers in advance to fix the ranking.

sentences.zh: 帝曰：「取士當務至公，豈容以己意升降，自今勿先進卷。」

translations.literal: The emperor said: "In selecting scholars one must pursue utmost fairness. How can one allow personal preference to raise or lower ranks? From now on do not submit the papers in advance."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said, "Selecting scholars demands absolute fairness. How can personal preference be allowed to raise or lower ranks? From now on, do not submit papers in advance."

sentences.zh: 三年，詔：「過省進士赴禦試不及者，令漕臣據元舉送狀申省，給敕賜同進士出身。

translations.literal: In the third year an edict stated: "Jinshi who passed the metropolitan examination but failed to qualify at the palace examination shall have the transport commissioner, on the basis of the original recommendation documents, report to the ministry and receive an edict granting fellow jinshi by origin.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year an edict ordered: "jinshi who had passed the metropolitan examination but failed at the palace examination should have the transport commissioner report to the ministry on the basis of the original recommendation documents and receive an edict conferring fellow jinshi by origin.

sentences.zh: 其計舉者，賜下州文學，並釋褐焉。」

translations.literal: Those counted in the quota shall be granted literary scholar of a lower prefecture, and all shall be released from commoner status."
translations.idiomatic: Those counted toward the quota were to receive the rank of literary scholar in a lower prefecture, and all were to be released from commoner status."

sentences.zh: 左司諫唐煇言：「舊制，省試用六曹尚書、翰林學士知貢舉，侍郎、給事中同知貢舉，卿監、郎官參詳，館職、學官點檢，御史監視，故能至公厭人心。

translations.literal: Left Remonstrance Bureau remonstrator Tang Hui said: "Under the old system the metropolitan examination used the six ministry directors and Hanlin academicians as chief examiners, vice ministers and drafting attendants as associate chief examiners, directorate officials and bureau officials for detailed review, academy appointees and school officials for inspection, and censors for supervision—thus it could achieve utmost fairness and satisfy public sentiment.
translations.idiomatic: Left Remonstrance Bureau remonstrator Tang Hui said, "Under the old system, for the metropolitan examination, ministers of the Six Ministries and Hanlin academicians knew the tribute examination; vice ministers and supervising secretaries jointly knew the tribute examination; court and directorate officials and bureau directors took part in detailed review; academy appointees and school officials inspected; and censors supervised, so that utmost fairness could be achieved and public confidence secured.

sentences.zh: 今諸道類試，顓委憲臣，奸弊滋生，才否貿亂，士論囂然，甚不稱更製設科之意，請並還禮部。」

translations.literal: Now the circuit classified examinations are wholly entrusted to judicial commissioners; fraud and abuse multiply, talent and mediocrity are confused in trade, and scholarly opinion is in uproar—this greatly fails to match the intent of reforming the examination system. I request that all be returned to the Ministry of Rites."
translations.idiomatic: Now the circuit classified examinations are entrusted entirely to judicial commissioners; fraud flourishes, merit and mediocrity are confused, and scholarly opinion is in uproar—far from the intent of the examination reforms. I ask that authority be restored entirely to the Ministry of Rites."

sentences.zh: 遂罷諸道類試。

translations.literal: Thereupon the circuit classified examinations were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: The circuit classified examinations were thereupon abolished.

sentences.zh: 四年，復川、陝試如故。

translations.literal: In the fourth year the Sichuan and Shaanxi examinations were restored as before.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year the Sichuan and Shaanxi examinations were restored to their former arrangement.

sentences.zh: 紹興元年，當祀明堂，復詔諸道類試，擇憲、漕或帥守中文學之人總其事，使精選考官。

translations.literal: In the first year of Shaoxing, when the Bright Hall sacrifice was due, an edict again ordered circuit classified examinations, selecting persons versed in letters among judicial commissioners, transport commissioners, or military commissioners and prefectural administrators to oversee them, and requiring careful selection of examiners.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Shaoxing, when the Bright Hall sacrifice was due, the court again ordered circuit classified examinations, choosing men of literary accomplishment among judicial commissioners, transport commissioners, or military commissioners and prefects to supervise them and requiring examiners to be chosen with care.

sentences.zh: 於是四川宣撫處置使張浚始以便宜令川、陝舉人，即置司州試之。

translations.literal: Thereupon Sichuan Pacification and Disposition Commissioner Zhang Jun first, by discretionary authority, ordered Sichuan and Shaanxi candidates to be examined at once at the seat of each army command.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon Sichuan Pacification and Disposition Commissioner Zhang Jun, exercising discretionary authority, first ordered Sichuan and Shaanxi candidates to be examined immediately at each army-command seat.

sentences.zh: 會侯延慶言：「兵興，太學既罷，諸生解散，行在職事及厘務官隨行有服親及門客，往往鄉貢隔絕，請立應舉法，以國子監進士為名。」

translations.literal: At this time Hou Yanqing said: "With the outbreak of war the Imperial University was suspended and students dispersed. Officials on duty at the temporary court and clerks in reorganization, together with their relatives within the mourning grades and retainers who accompanied them, are often cut off from local recommendation. I request that a method for sitting examinations be established under the designation Directorate of Education jinshi."
translations.idiomatic: At this time Hou Yanqing said, "With war underway the Imperial University had been suspended and students dispersed. Officials serving at the mobile court and reorganization clerks, along with relatives within the mourning grades and retainers who accompanied them, were often cut off from local recommendation. I ask that a procedure for sitting examinations be established under the designation Directorate of Education jinshi."

sentences.zh: 令轉運司附試。

translations.literal: They were ordered to take attached examinations at the transport commission.
translations.idiomatic: They were ordered to take attached examinations at the transport commissions.

sentences.zh: 又詔：「京畿、京東西、河北、陝西、淮南士人轉徙東南者，令於寓戶州軍附試，別號取放。」

translations.literal: Another edict stated: "Scholars of the capital region, Eastern and Western Capital circuits, Hebei, Shaanxi, and Huainan who have relocated to the southeast shall take attached examinations in the prefectures and army commands where they reside, with separate quotas for admission."
translations.idiomatic: Another edict ordered: "scholars of the capital region, the Eastern and Western Capital circuits, Hebei, Shaanxi, and Huainan who had relocated to the southeast should take attached examinations in the prefectures and army commands where they resided, with separate admission quotas."

sentences.zh: 時諸道貢籍多毀於兵，乃詔轉運司令舉人具元符以後得解、升貢、戶貫、三代、治經，置籍於禮部，以稽考焉。

translations.literal: At that time recommendation registers in the circuits were largely destroyed in the war. An edict ordered transport commissioners to have candidates furnish, since the Yuanfu era, their qualification for exemption, advancement to recommendation, household registration, three generations, and classic studied, and registers were placed in the Ministry of Rites for verification.
translations.idiomatic: At that time recommendation registers throughout the circuits had been largely destroyed in the war. The court ordered transport commissioners to have candidates submit, for the period since the Yuanfu era, records of qualification for exemption, advancement to recommendation, household registration, three generations, and the classic they studied; registers were kept at the Ministry of Rites for verification.

sentences.zh: 應該恩免解舉人，值兵毀失公據者，召京官二員委保，所在州軍給據，仍申部注籍。

translations.literal: Candidates entitled to grace exemption from the qualifying examination whose public documents were destroyed in the war were to summon two capital officials to guarantee them; the local prefecture or army command would issue documents, and they would still report to the ministry for registry.
translations.idiomatic: Candidates entitled to grace exemption whose official documents had been destroyed in the war were to obtain guarantees from two capital officials; the local prefecture or army command would issue new documents, and their names would still be registered with the ministry.

sentences.zh: 侍御史曾統請取士止用詞賦，未須兼經，高宗亦以古今治亂多載於史，經義登科者類不通史，將從其議。

translations.literal: Attending censor Zeng Tong requested that recruitment use only regulated verse and rhapsody, without requiring classics as well. Emperor Gaozong also held that the rise and fall of order in past and present is largely recorded in history, and those who passed through classic elucidation generally did not know history; he was about to accept the proposal.
translations.idiomatic: Attending censor Zeng Tong asked that recruitment rely solely on regulated verse and rhapsody, without also requiring the classics. Emperor Gaozong likewise observed that the rise and fall of states in past and present times is recorded chiefly in history, and that those who passed through the classic-elucidation track generally knew little history; he was inclined to accept the proposal.

sentences.zh: 左僕射呂頤浩曰：「經義、詞賦均以言取人，宜如舊。」

translations.literal: Left Grand Counselor Lü Yihao said: "Classic elucidation and regulated verse and rhapsody alike select men by their writing; the old system should be maintained."
translations.idiomatic: Left Grand Counselor Lü Yihao said, "Classic elucidation and regulated verse and rhapsody alike select men by their writing; the former arrangement should be kept."

sentences.zh: 遂止。

translations.literal: The matter was thereupon dropped.
translations.idiomatic: The proposal was dropped.

sentences.zh: 二年，廷試，手詔諭考官，當崇直言，抑諛佞。

translations.literal: In the second year, at the court examination, a handwritten edict instructed the examiners to value forthright speech and suppress flattery and sycophancy.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year, at the court examination, the emperor's handwritten edict instructed the examiners to value forthright speech and suppress flattery and sycophancy.

sentences.zh: 得張九成以下二百五十九人，淩景夏第二。

translations.literal: Two hundred fifty-nine candidates from Zhang Jiucheng downward were selected; Ling Jingxia placed second.
translations.idiomatic: Two hundred fifty-nine candidates from Zhang Jiucheng downward were selected; Ling Jingxia placed second.

sentences.zh: 呂頤浩言景夏詞勝九成，請更寘第一。

translations.literal: Lü Yihao said Jingxia's compositions surpassed Jiucheng's and requested that he be placed first instead.
translations.idiomatic: Lü Yihao said that Jingxia's compositions surpassed Jiucheng's and asked that he be placed first instead.

sentences.zh: 帝曰：「士人初進，便須別其忠佞，九成所對，無所畏避，宜擢首選。」

translations.literal: The emperor said: "When scholars first enter service one must distinguish the loyal from the sycophantic. Jiucheng's answers showed no fear or evasion; he should be raised to first place."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said, "When scholars first enter service one must distinguish the loyal from the sycophantic. Jiucheng's answers showed no fear or evasion; he should be placed first."

sentences.zh: 九成以類試、廷策俱第一，命特進一官。

translations.literal: Jiucheng ranked first in both the classified examination and the court policy questions; he was ordered specially advanced one rank.
translations.idiomatic: Because Jiucheng had ranked first in both the classified examination and the court policy questions, he was ordered advanced one rank as a special reward.

sentences.zh: 時進士卷有犯御名者，帝曰：「豈以朕名妨人進取邪？」

translations.literal: At that time some jinshi papers violated the imperial taboo name. The emperor said: "How can my name be allowed to obstruct others' advancement?"
translations.idiomatic: At that time some jinshi examination papers violated the imperial taboo name. The emperor said, "How can my name be allowed to obstruct anyone's advancement?"

sentences.zh: 令寘本等。

translations.literal: He ordered them placed in their proper grade.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered them placed in their proper grade.

sentences.zh: 又命應及第人各進一秩。

translations.literal: He also ordered each successful candidate advanced one rank.
translations.idiomatic: He also ordered each successful candidate advanced one rank.

sentences.zh: 舊制，潛藩州郡舉人，必曾請舉兩到省已上乃得試。

translations.literal: Under the old system, candidates from prefectures of a prince's hidden fief had to have requested recommendation and reached the metropolitan examination at least twice before they could sit for examination.
translations.idiomatic: Under the old system, candidates from prefectures of a prince's hidden fief had to have been recommended and reached the metropolitan examination at least twice before they could sit for examination.

sentences.zh: 帝嘗封蜀國公，是年，蜀州舉人以帝登極恩，徑赴類省試，自是為例。

translations.literal: The emperor had once been enfeoffed as Duke of Shu. That year Shu Prefecture candidates, by grace of the emperor's accession, proceeded directly to the classified metropolitan examination; this thereafter became precedent.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor had once been enfeoffed as Duke of Shu. That year candidates from Shu Prefecture, by grace of his accession, proceeded directly to the classified metropolitan examination, and this thereafter became precedent.

sentences.zh: 五年，初試進士於南省，戒飭有司：「商搉去取，毋以絺繪章句為工，當以淵源學問為尚。

translations.literal: In the fifth year the jinshi examination was first held at the Southern Directorate. Officials were admonished: "In weighing selection and rejection, do not take ornate phrasing and polished clauses as the standard of excellence; profound learning should be esteemed.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year the jinshi examination was first held at the Southern Directorate. Officials were admonished: "In weighing admission and rejection, do not treat ornate phrasing and polished clauses as the standard of excellence; profound learning should be esteemed.

sentences.zh: 事關教化、有益治體者，毋以切直為嫌。

translations.literal: Matters bearing on moral transformation and benefiting the structure of governance should not be rejected on account of blunt directness.
translations.idiomatic: Essays bearing on moral transformation and benefiting governance should not be rejected merely for blunt directness.

sentences.zh: 言無根柢、肆為蔓衍者，不在采錄。」

translations.literal: Those whose words lack foundation and who indulge in rambling expansion are not to be admitted."
translations.idiomatic: Those whose arguments lack foundation and who indulge in rambling expansion are not to be admitted."

sentences.zh: 「舉人程文，許通用古今諸儒之說，及出己意，文理優長為合格。」

translations.literal: Candidates' examination compositions may freely employ the doctrines of ancient and modern Confucians and may also set forth their own views; excellence in reasoning and style qualifies as passing."
translations.idiomatic: "Candidates' examination compositions may freely employ the doctrines of ancient and modern Confucians and may also set forth their own views; excellence in reasoning and style qualifies as passing."

sentences.zh: 三月，禦試奏名，汪應辰第一。

translations.literal: In the third month, at the palace examination for listed candidates, Wang Yingchen placed first.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, at the palace examination for listed candidates, Wang Yingchen placed first.

sentences.zh: 初，考官以有官人黃中第一，帝訪諸沈應求，應求以沈遘與馮京故事對，乃更擢應辰為魁，遂為定制。

translations.literal: Initially the examiners ranked the incumbent official Huang Zhong first. The emperor consulted Shen Yingqiu, who replied with the precedents of Shen Kuo and Feng Jing; Yingchen was thereupon raised to top place, and this became fixed regulation.
translations.idiomatic: Initially the examiners had ranked the incumbent official Huang Zhong first. The emperor consulted Shen Yingqiu, who cited the precedents of Shen Kuo and Feng Jing; Yingchen was thereupon raised to first place, and this became fixed practice.

sentences.zh: 舊制。

translations.literal: Under the old system:
translations.idiomatic: Under the old system:

sentences.zh: 禦試初考既分等第，印封送覆考定之，詳定所或從初，或從覆，不許別自立等。

translations.literal: after the palace examination's initial review had assigned grades, the papers were sealed and sent to the re-review for final determination; the detailed review office might follow either the initial or the re-review and was not permitted to establish grades on its own.
translations.idiomatic: after the palace examination's initial review had assigned grades, the papers were sealed and sent to the re-review for final determination; the detailed review office might follow either the initial or the re-review and was not permitted to establish grades on its own.

sentences.zh: 嘉祐中廢。

translations.literal: This was abolished in the Jiayou era.
translations.idiomatic: This was abolished in the Jiayou era.

sentences.zh: 至是，知制誥孫近奏：「若遵舊制，則高下升黜，盡出詳定官，初、覆考為虛設。

translations.literal: At this time Drafter Sun Jin memorialized: "If the old system is followed, promotion and demotion in rank will all depend on the detailed review officials, and the initial and re-reviews will be empty formalities.
translations.idiomatic: At this time Drafter Sun Jin memorialized, "If the old system is followed, promotion and demotion in rank will depend entirely on the detailed review officials, and the initial and re-reviews will be empty formalities.

sentences.zh: 請自今初、覆考皆未當，始許奏稟別置等第。」

translations.literal: I request that from now on, only when both initial and re-reviews are unsatisfactory may a memorial be submitted to establish grades separately."
translations.idiomatic: I ask that from now on separate grades may be established by memorial only when both initial and re-reviews are unsatisfactory."

sentences.zh: 諫議大夫趙霈請用《崇寧令》，凡隔二等、累及五人許行奏稟，從之。

translations.literal: Remonstrance and Policy Grandee Zhao Pei requested application of the Chongning statutes: whenever there was a gap of two grades or five persons involved cumulatively, memorial submission was permitted; this was approved.
translations.idiomatic: Remonstrance and Policy Grandee Zhao Pei asked that the Chongning statutes be applied: whenever there was a gap of two grades or five persons involved cumulatively, memorial submission was permitted; the request was approved.

sentences.zh: 是年，川、陝進士止試宣撫司，特奏名則置院差官，試時務策一道，禮部具取放分數、推恩等第頒示之。

translations.literal: That year Sichuan and Shaanxi jinshi were examined only at the Pacification Commission. For special listed candidates an office was established and officials dispatched; they were examined on one current-affairs policy question, and the Ministry of Rites furnished the admission scores and grades of favor for promulgation.
translations.idiomatic: That year Sichuan and Shaanxi jinshi were examined only at the Pacification Commission. For special listed candidates an office was established and officials dispatched; they faced one current-affairs policy question, and the Ministry of Rites supplied the admission scores and favor grades for promulgation.

sentences.zh: 舊法，隨侍見任守倅等官，在本貫二千里外，曰滿裏子弟。

translations.literal: Under the old law, sons and younger brothers accompanying incumbent prefectural administrators, vice commissioners, and the like, when more than two thousand li from their native place, were called "full-distance native sons and brothers."
translations.idiomatic: Under the old law, sons and younger brothers accompanying incumbent prefectural administrators, vice commissioners, and the like who were more than two thousand li from their native place were called "full-distance native sons and brothers."

sentences.zh: 試官內外有服親及婚姻家，曰「避親」。

translations.literal: Those with relatives within the mourning grades inside or outside the examiner's office, or connected by marriage, were called "kin avoidance."
translations.idiomatic: Those with relatives within the mourning grades inside or outside the examiner's office, or connected by marriage, were called "kin avoidance."

sentences.zh: 館於見任門下，曰「門客」。

translations.literal: Those lodged under an incumbent patron were called "retainers."
translations.idiomatic: Those lodged under an incumbent patron were called "retainers."

sentences.zh: 是三等許牒試，否則不預。

translations.literal: These three categories were permitted document examinations; otherwise they did not participate.
translations.idiomatic: These three categories were permitted document examinations; otherwise they did not participate.

sentences.zh: 間有背本宗而竄他譜，飛賕而移試他道者，議者病之。

translations.literal: Occasionally some turned against their own lineage and inserted themselves in other genealogies, or used bribery to shift their examination to another circuit—critics deplored this.
translations.idiomatic: Occasionally some abandoned their own lineage to insert themselves in other genealogies, or used bribery to shift their examination to another circuit—critics deplored the practice.

sentences.zh: 六年，詔牒試應避者，令本司長官、州守倅、縣令委保，詭冒者連坐。

translations.literal: In the sixth year an edict ordered that for document examinations subject to avoidance, the chief of the relevant office, prefectural administrator or vice commissioner, and county magistrate should guarantee them; those guilty of fraud would be punished collectively.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year an edict ordered that for document examinations subject to avoidance, the chief of the relevant office, the prefectural administrator or vice commissioner, and the county magistrate should guarantee the candidates; those guilty of fraud would be punished collectively.

sentences.zh: 七年，命行在職事、厘務官並宗子應舉、取應及有官人，並於行在赴國子監試，始命各差詞賦、經義考官。

translations.literal: In the seventh year officials on duty at the temporary court, reorganization clerks, imperial clansmen sitting for examination, those taking special examinations, and persons already holding office were all ordered to take the Directorate of Education examination at the temporary court; examiners for regulated verse and rhapsody and for classic elucidation were first appointed separately.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year officials serving at the mobile court, reorganization clerks, imperial clansmen sitting for examination, those taking special examinations, and persons already holding office were all ordered to take the Directorate of Education examination at the mobile court; separate examiners for regulated verse and rhapsody and for classic elucidation were appointed for the first time.

sentences.zh: 八年，以平江府四經巡幸，其得解舉人援臨安、建康駐蹕例，各免文解一次。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, because Pingjiang Prefecture had received four imperial visits, its qualified candidates were granted, by the precedent of encampment at Lin'an and Jiankang, one exemption from the literary qualifying examination each.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year, because Pingjiang Prefecture had received four imperial visits, its qualified candidates were granted, following the precedent of the court's residence at Lin'an and Jiankang, one exemption from the literary qualifying examination each.

sentences.zh: 時聞徽宗崩，未及大祥，禮部言：故事，因諒闇罷殿試，則省試第一人為榜首，補兩使職官。

translations.literal: At that time word came that Emperor Huizong had died, before the completion of major mourning. The Ministry of Rites said: By precedent, when the palace examination is suspended because of imperial mourning, the first place in the metropolitan examination becomes top candidate and is appointed to a two-envoy office.
translations.idiomatic: At that time word came that Emperor Huizong had died, before the completion of major mourning. The Ministry of Rites said that by precedent, when the palace examination was suspended because of imperial mourning, the first place in the metropolitan examination became top candidate and was appointed to a two-envoy office.

sentences.zh: 帝特命為左承事郎，自此率以為常。

translations.literal: The emperor specially ordered the rank Left Assistant Master; from this it generally became regular practice.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor specially ordered the rank of Left Assistant Master; from this it generally became regular practice.

sentences.zh: 九年，以陝西舉人久蹈北境，理宜優異，非四川比，令禮部別號取放。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, because Shaanxi candidates had long suffered in the northern territories, they ought by right to receive special favor and were not comparable to Sichuan; the Ministry of Rites was ordered to admit them under separate quotas.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year, because Shaanxi candidates had long suffered in the northern territories and deserved special favor unlike Sichuan, the Ministry of Rites was ordered to admit them under separate quotas.

sentences.zh: 川、陝分類試額自此始。

translations.literal: Separate classified examination quotas for Sichuan and Shaanxi began from this.
translations.idiomatic: Separate classified examination quotas for Sichuan and Shaanxi began from this point.

sentences.zh: 是歲，以科試、明堂同在嗣歲，省司財計艱於辦給，又患初仕待闕率四五年，若使進士、蔭人同時差注，俱為不便，增展一年，則合舊制。

translations.literal: That year, because the examination and the Bright Hall sacrifice both fell in the following year, provincial departments found finances hard to supply; it was also feared that new appointees waited four or five years for posts on average, and that if jinshi and yin beneficiaries were assigned simultaneously it would be inconvenient for all—extending by one year would accord with the old system.
translations.idiomatic: That year, because the examination and the Bright Hall sacrifice both fell in the following year, provincial departments found finances difficult to supply; it was also feared that new appointees waited four or five years for posts on average, and that simultaneous assignment of jinshi and yin beneficiaries would be inconvenient for all—extending the schedule by one year would accord with the old system.

sentences.zh: 十年，遂詔諸州依條發解，十二年正月省試，三月禦試，後皆準此。

translations.literal: In the tenth year an edict ordered all prefectures to send up candidates according to statute; the metropolitan examination in the first month of the twelfth year and the palace examination in the third month—thereafter all followed this.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year an edict ordered all prefectures to send up candidates according to statute; the metropolitan examination in the first month of the twelfth year and the palace examination in the third month became the standard thereafter.

sentences.zh: 十三年，國子司業高閌言：「取士當先經術。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year Directorate Vice Director Gao Chong said: "In recruiting scholars, classical learning should come first.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year Directorate Vice Director Gao Chong said, "In recruiting scholars, classical learning should come first.

sentences.zh: 請參合三場，以本經、《語》、《孟》義各一道為首，詩賦各一首次之，子史論一道、時務策一道又次之，庶幾如古試法。

translations.literal: I request combining the three sessions: one question each on the base classic, the Analects, and Mencius first; one poem and one rhapsody next; one discourse on the masters and histories and one current-affairs policy question after that—thus approximating the ancient examination method.
translations.idiomatic: I ask that the three sessions be combined: one question each on the base classic, the Analects, and Mencius first; one poem and one rhapsody next; one discourse on the masters and histories and one current-affairs policy question after that—thus approximating the ancient examination method.

sentences.zh: 又《春秋》義當於正經出題。」

translations.literal: Also, Spring and Autumn questions should be drawn from the canonical text.
translations.idiomatic: Spring and Autumn questions should also be drawn from the canonical text."

sentences.zh: 並從之。

translations.literal: All was approved.
translations.idiomatic: All was approved.

sentences.zh: 初立同文館試，凡居行在去本貫及千里已上者，許附試於國子監。

translations.literal: The Tongwen Hall examination was first established: all who resided at the temporary court more than one thousand li from their native place were permitted attached examination at the Directorate of Education.
translations.idiomatic: The Tongwen Hall examination was first established: all who resided at the mobile court more than one thousand li from their native place were permitted attached examination at the Directorate of Education.

sentences.zh: 十五年，凡特奏名賜同學究出身者，舊京府助教今改將仕郎。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year, all special listed candidates granted fellow student-scholar by origin—formerly capital prefecture assistant instructors—were now changed to Awaiting Office Gentleman.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year, all special listed candidates granted fellow student-scholar by origin—formerly capital prefecture assistant instructors—were now given the rank of Awaiting Office Gentleman.

sentences.zh: 是歲，始定依汴京舊制，正奏及特恩分兩日唱名。

translations.literal: That year it was first fixed, following the old Bianjing system, that regular listed candidates and special grace candidates would have their names announced on two separate days.
translations.idiomatic: That year it was first fixed, following the old Bianjing system, that regular listed candidates and special grace candidates would have their names announced on two separate days.

sentences.zh: 十七年，申禁程文全用本朝人文集或歌頌及佛書全句者，皆不考。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year the prohibition was reiterated: examination compositions that wholly used collected works of this dynasty's writers, or eulogies and hymns, or complete sentences from Buddhist books, were all not to be examined.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year the prohibition was reiterated: examination compositions that wholly reproduced collected works of this dynasty's writers, eulogies and hymns, or complete sentences from Buddhist books were not to be examined at all.

sentences.zh: 十八年，以浙漕舉人有勢家行賂、假手濫名者，諭有司立賞格，聽人捕告。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year, because Zhejiang transport commission candidates included powerful families who bribed officials and used proxies to obtain names improperly, officials were instructed to establish reward schedules and permit people to arrest and report offenders.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year, because Zhejiang transport commission candidates included powerful families who bribed officials and used proxies to obtain names improperly, officials were instructed to establish reward schedules and permit people to arrest and report offenders.

sentences.zh: 十九年，詔：「自今鄉貢，前一歲，州軍屬縣長吏籍定合應舉人，以次年春縣上之州，州下之學，核實引保，赴鄉飲酒，然後送試院。

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year an edict stated: "From now on for local recommendation, one year in advance the chief officials of counties subordinate to prefectures and army commands shall register those qualified to sit for examination; in the spring of the following year the county shall report to the prefecture, the prefecture to the school, verify and guarantee them, have them attend the district drinking ceremony, and then send them to the examination hall.
translations.idiomatic: In the nineteenth year an edict ordered: "for local recommendation, one year in advance the chief officials of counties subordinate to prefectures and army commands should register those qualified to sit for examination; in the spring of the following year the county should report to the prefecture, the prefecture to the school, verify and guarantee them, have them attend the district drinking ceremony, and then send them to the examination hall.

sentences.zh: 及期投狀射保者勿受。」

translations.literal: When the time comes, those who submit documents seeking guarantors at the last moment shall not be accepted."
translations.idiomatic: When the time came, those who submitted documents seeking guarantors at the last moment were not to be accepted."

sentences.zh: 自神宗朝程顥、程頤以道學倡於洛，四方師之，中興盛於東南，科舉之文稍用頤說。

translations.literal: From the Shenzong era Cheng Hao and Cheng Yi had advocated the Learning of the Way at Luoyang, and scholars from all quarters took them as teachers. After the restoration it flourished in the southeast, and examination compositions gradually employed Yi's doctrines.
translations.idiomatic: From the Shenzong era Cheng Hao and Cheng Yi had advocated the Learning of the Way at Luoyang, and scholars from all quarters took them as teachers. After the restoration it flourished in the southeast, and examination compositions gradually employed Yi's doctrines.

sentences.zh: 諫官陳公輔上疏詆頤學，乞加禁絕；

translations.literal: Remonstrance official Chen Gongfu submitted a memorial slandering Yi's learning and requesting that it be strictly prohibited;
translations.idiomatic: Remonstrance official Chen Gongfu submitted a memorial attacking Yi's learning and requesting that it be strictly prohibited;

sentences.zh: 秦檜入相，甚至指頤為「專門」，侍御史汪勃請戒飭攸司，凡專門曲說，必加黜落；

translations.literal: when Qin Hui entered the chancellorship he even labeled Yi as "sectarian." Attending censor Wang Bo requested that relevant offices be admonished: whenever sectarian or distorted doctrines appeared, they must be rejected;
translations.idiomatic: when Qin Hui entered the chancellorship he even labeled Yi as "sectarian." Attending censor Wang Bo asked that relevant offices be admonished: whenever sectarian or distorted doctrines appeared, they must be rejected;

sentences.zh: 中丞曹筠亦請選汰用程說者：並從之。

translations.literal: Vice Censor-in-Chief Cao Jun also requested screening out those who employed Cheng's doctrines: all was approved.
translations.idiomatic: Vice Censor-in-Chief Cao Jun also asked that those who employed Cheng's doctrines be screened out: all was approved.

sentences.zh: 二十一年，禦試得正奏名四百人，特奏名五百三十一人。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year the palace examination produced four hundred regular listed candidates and five hundred thirty-one special listed candidates.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-first year the palace examination produced four hundred regular listed candidates and five hundred thirty-one special listed candidates.

sentences.zh: 中興以來，得人始盛。

translations.literal: Since the restoration, recruitment of talent first became abundant.
translations.idiomatic: Since the restoration, recruitment of talent first became abundant.

sentences.zh: 二十二年，以士習《周禮》、《禮記》，較他經十無一二，恐其學浸廢，遂命州郡招延明於《二禮》者，俾立講說以表學校，及令考官優加誘進。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year, because scholars studying the Rites of Zhou and the Record of Rites were scarcely one or two in ten compared with other classics, fearing that this learning would gradually be abandoned, prefectures and districts were ordered to invite men expert in the Two Rites to establish lectures to display the schools, and examiners were ordered to encourage and advance them preferentially.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-second year, because scholars studying the Rites of Zhou and the Record of Rites were scarcely one or two in ten compared with other classics, fearing that this learning would gradually die out, prefectures and districts were ordered to invite men expert in the Two Rites to establish lectures to display the schools, and examiners were ordered to encourage and advance them preferentially.

sentences.zh: 舊諸州皆以八月選日試舉人，有趁數州取解者。

translations.literal: Formerly all prefectures chose a day in the eighth month to examine candidates; some took qualifying examinations in several prefectures to seize quotas.
translations.idiomatic: Formerly all prefectures chose a day in the eighth month to examine candidates; some seized qualifying examinations in several prefectures to maximize their chances.

sentences.zh: 二十四年，始定試期並用中秋日，四川則用季春，而仲秋類省。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year examination dates were first fixed: all used the Mid-Autumn Festival day; Sichuan used late spring, with classified metropolitan examination in mid-autumn.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fourth year examination dates were first fixed: all used the Mid-Autumn Festival day; Sichuan used late spring, with the classified metropolitan examination in mid-autumn.

sentences.zh: 初，秦檜專國，其子熺廷試第一，檜陽引降第二名。

translations.literal: Earlier, when Qin Hui monopolized the state, his son Qin Xi placed first in the court examination; Hui pretended to demote him to second place.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, when Qin Hui monopolized the state, his son Qin Xi placed first in the court examination; Hui pretended to demote him to second place.

sentences.zh: 是歲，檜孫塤舉進士，省試、廷對皆首選，姻黨曹冠等皆居高甲，後降塤第三。

translations.literal: That year Hui's grandson Qin Sun sat for the jinshi examination; in both the metropolitan examination and the court policy questions he ranked first, and affinal kin such as Cao Guan all placed in the upper grades—later Sun was demoted to third place.
translations.idiomatic: That year Hui's grandson Qin Sun sat for the jinshi examination; in both the metropolitan examination and the court policy questions he ranked first, and affinal kin such as Cao Guan all placed in the upper grades—later Sun was demoted to third place.

sentences.zh: 二十五年，檜死，帝懲其弊，遂命貢院遵故事，凡合格舉人有權要親族，並令覆試。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fifth year Hui died. The emperor, punishing these abuses, ordered the examination hall to follow precedent: all qualified candidates who were kin of powerful persons were to be re-examined.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fifth year Hui died. The emperor, punishing these abuses, ordered the examination hall to follow precedent: all qualified candidates who were kin of powerful persons were to be re-examined.

sentences.zh: 仍奪塤出身，改冠等七人階官並帶「右」字，餘悉駁放。

translations.literal: Sun's degree by origin was still revoked; Guan and six others had their rank titles changed to include the character "Right," and the rest were all rejected and dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Sun's degree by origin was still revoked; Guan and six others had their rank titles changed to include the character "Right," and the rest were all rejected and dismissed.

sentences.zh: 程、王之學，數年以來，宰相執論不一，趙鼎主程頤，秦檜主王安石。

translations.literal: For several years the learning of the Cheng brothers and Wang Anshi had been disputed among chancellors without unity: Zhao Ding upheld Cheng Yi, Qin Hui upheld Wang Anshi.
translations.idiomatic: For several years the learning of the Cheng brothers and Wang Anshi had divided the chancellors: Zhao Ding upheld Cheng Yi, Qin Hui upheld Wang Anshi.

sentences.zh: 至是，詔自今毋拘一家之說，務求至當之論。

translations.literal: At this time an edict stated that from now on no single school's doctrine should be restricted; utmost proper doctrine should be sought.
translations.idiomatic: At this time an edict ordered that from then on no single school's doctrine should be binding and that the most correct doctrine should be sought.

sentences.zh: 道學之禁稍解矣。

translations.literal: The prohibition on the Learning of the Way was somewhat relaxed.
translations.idiomatic: The prohibition on the Learning of the Way was somewhat relaxed.

sentences.zh: 自經、賦分科，聲律日盛，帝嘗曰：「向為士不讀史，遂用詩賦。

translations.literal: Since classics and rhapsody were divided into separate tracks, prosodic rules daily flourished. The emperor once said: "Formerly, because scholars did not read history, poetry and rhapsody were used.
translations.idiomatic: Since classics and rhapsody were divided into separate tracks, prosodic rules grew ever more prominent. The emperor once said, "Formerly, because scholars did not read history, poetry and rhapsody were used.

sentences.zh: 今則不讀經，不出數年，經學廢矣。」

translations.literal: Now they do not read the classics; within a few years classic learning will be abandoned."
translations.idiomatic: Now they do not read the classics; within a few years classic learning will be abandoned."

sentences.zh: 二十七年，詔復行兼經，如十三年之制。

translations.literal: In the twenty-seventh year an edict restored combined classics, as in the thirteenth-year system.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-seventh year an edict restored the combined-classics format used in the thirteenth year.

sentences.zh: 內第一場大小經義各減一道，如治《二禮》文義優長，許侵用諸經分數。

translations.literal: In the first session one question each on major and minor classic elucidation was reduced; if one studying the Two Rites excelled in literary exposition, he was permitted to draw on other classics' quotas.
translations.idiomatic: In the first session one question each on major and minor classic elucidation was reduced; if a candidate in the Two Rites excelled in literary exposition, he might draw on quotas from other classics.

sentences.zh: 時號為四科。

translations.literal: It was then called the four tracks.
translations.idiomatic: The arrangement was then called the four tracks.

sentences.zh: 舊蜀士赴廷試不及者，皆賜同進士出身。

translations.literal: Formerly Sichuan scholars who failed to reach the court examination were all granted fellow jinshi by origin.
translations.idiomatic: Formerly Sichuan scholars who failed to reach the court examination were all granted fellow jinshi by origin.

sentences.zh: 帝念其中有俊秀能取高第者，不宜例置下列，至是，遂諭都省寬展試期以待之。

translations.literal: The emperor thought that among them were outstanding talents who could win high ranks and should not routinely be placed in the lower grades; at this time he ordered the Department of State Affairs to extend the examination period to wait for them.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor thought that among them were outstanding talents capable of high ranks who should not routinely be placed in the lower grades; he therefore ordered the Department of State Affairs to extend the examination period to wait for them.

sentences.zh: 及唱名，閻安中第二，梁介第三，皆蜀士也，帝大悅。

translations.literal: When names were announced, Yan Anzhong placed second and Liang Jie third—both Sichuan scholars—and the emperor was greatly pleased.
translations.idiomatic: When names were announced, Yan Anzhong placed second and Liang Jie third—both Sichuan scholars—and the emperor was greatly pleased.

sentences.zh: 二十九年，孫道夫在經筵，極論四川類試請托之弊，請盡令赴禮部。

translations.literal: In the twenty-ninth year Sun Daofu at the Classics Lectures urgently discussed the abuses of patronage in Sichuan's classified examinations and requested that all be sent to the Ministry of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-ninth year Sun Daofu at the Classics Lectures urgently discussed the abuses of patronage in Sichuan's classified examinations and asked that all candidates be sent to the Ministry of Rites.

sentences.zh: 帝曰：「後舉但當遣御史監之。」

translations.literal: The emperor said: "In future examinations censors should simply be dispatched to supervise."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said, "In future examinations censors should simply be dispatched to supervise."

sentences.zh: 道夫持益堅，事下國子監，祭酒楊椿曰：「蜀去行在萬里，可使士子涉三峽、冒重湖邪？

translations.literal: Daofu held all the firmer. The matter was referred to the Directorate of Education; Libationer Yang Chun said: "Shu is ten thousand li from the temporary court—can one make scholars cross the Three Gorges and brave the heavy lakes?
translations.idiomatic: Daofu held firm. The matter was referred to the Directorate of Education; Libationer Yang Chun said, "Shu is ten thousand li from the mobile court—can scholars be made to cross the Three Gorges and brave the heavy lakes?

sentences.zh: 欲革其弊，一監試得人足矣。」

translations.literal: To reform the abuses, one capable supervising examiner suffices."
translations.idiomatic: To reform the abuses, one capable supervising examiner is enough."

sentences.zh: 遂詔監司，守倅賓客力可行者赴省，餘不在遣中。

translations.literal: Thereupon circuit commissioners were ordered: only retainers of prefectural administrators and vice commissioners who could travel were to go to the metropolitan examination; the rest were not in the dispatch.
translations.idiomatic: Circuit commissioners were thereupon ordered that only retainers of prefectural administrators and vice commissioners who could travel should go to the metropolitan examination; the rest were not included in the dispatch.

sentences.zh: 是歲，四川類省試始從朝廷差官。

translations.literal: That year Sichuan's classified metropolitan examination first had officials dispatched from the court.
translations.idiomatic: That year officials were first dispatched from the court for Sichuan's classified metropolitan examination.

sentences.zh: 初，類試第一人恩數優厚，視殿試第三人，賜進士及第；

translations.literal: Initially the first place in classified examination received generous favor, equaling the third place in the palace examination, and was granted jinshi with honors;
translations.idiomatic: Initially the first place in the classified examination received generous favor equal to third place in the palace examination and was granted jinshi with honors;

sentences.zh: 後以何耕對策忤秦檜，乃改禮部類試蜀士第一等人，並賜進士出身，自是無有不赴禦試者。

translations.literal: Later because He Geng's policy answers offended Qin Hui, it was changed so that first-place Sichuan candidates in the Ministry's classified examination all received jinshi by origin; from then on none failed to attend the palace examination.
translations.idiomatic: Later, because He Geng's policy answers offended Qin Hui, first-place Sichuan candidates in the Ministry's classified examination were all granted jinshi by origin instead; from then on none failed to attend the palace examination.

sentences.zh: 惟遇不親策，則類省試第一人恩數如舊，第二、第三人皆附第一甲，九名以上附第二甲焉。

translations.literal: Only when the emperor did not examine in person did the first place in classified metropolitan examination receive favor as before; second and third were attached to the first class, nine places and above to the second class.
translations.idiomatic: Only when the emperor did not examine in person did the first place in the classified metropolitan examination receive favor as before; second and third were attached to the first class, and nine places and above to the second class.

sentences.zh: 是年詔：「四川等處進士，路遠歸鄉試不及者，特就運司附試一次，仍別行考校，取旨立額。」

translations.literal: That year an edict stated: "Jinshi of Sichuan and other regions who, because of the long journey, cannot return home for local examination in time may specially take one attached examination at the transport commission, with separate evaluation and quota established by imperial order."
translations.idiomatic: That year an edict ordered: "jinshi from Sichuan and other regions who, because of the long journey, could not return home for local examination in time might take one attached examination at the transport commission, with separate evaluation and a quota established by imperial order."

sentences.zh: 三十一年，禮部侍郎金安節言：「熙寧、元豐以來，經義詩賦，廢興離合，隨時更革，初無定制。

translations.literal: In the thirty-first year Vice Minister of Rites Jin Anjie said: "Since Xining and Yuanfeng, classic elucidation and poetry-rhapsody have been abolished, restored, combined, and separated with the times—initially without fixed regulation.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-first year Vice Minister of Rites Jin Anjie said, "Since Xining and Yuanfeng, classic elucidation and poetry-rhapsody have been abolished, restored, combined, and separated with the times, without any fixed regulation.

sentences.zh: 近合科以來，通經者苦賦體雕刻，習賦者病經旨淵微，心有弗精，智難兼濟。

translations.literal: Since the recent combined track, those versed in classics suffer from rhapsody's ornamental carving; those skilled in rhapsody find classic meanings too profound—minds not refined, talents hard to combine.
translations.idiomatic: Since the recent combined track, those versed in classics suffer from rhapsody's ornamental carving, while those skilled in rhapsody find classic meanings too profound—minds are not refined enough, and talents are hard to combine.

sentences.zh: 又其甚者，論既並場，策問太寡，議論器識，無以盡人。

translations.literal: Worse still, when discourses were combined in one session and policy questions too few, discussion, judgment, and capacity could not fully reveal a person.
translations.idiomatic: Worse still, when discourses were combined in one session and policy questions too few, a candidate's judgment and capacity could not be fully revealed.

sentences.zh: 士守傳注，史學盡廢，此後進往往得志，而老生宿儒多困也。

translations.literal: Scholars clung to commentarial traditions; historical learning was wholly abandoned—junior men often succeeded while old scholars were mostly trapped.
translations.idiomatic: Scholars clung to commentarial traditions while historical learning was abandoned; junior men often succeeded while old scholars were left behind.

sentences.zh: 請復立兩科，永為成憲。」

translations.literal: I request restoring two separate tracks as permanent statute."
translations.idiomatic: I ask that two separate tracks be restored as permanent statute."

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: This was approved.
translations.idiomatic: This was approved.

sentences.zh: 於是士始有定向，而得專所習矣。

translations.literal: Thus scholars first had fixed direction and could specialize in what they studied.
translations.idiomatic: Scholars then had a fixed direction and could specialize in what they studied.

sentences.zh: 既而建議者以為兩科既分，解額未定，宜以國學及諸州解額三分為率，二取經義，一取詩賦。

translations.literal: Then memorialists said that with two tracks divided and quotas unset, National University and prefectural quotas should be divided in thirds—two parts classic elucidation, one poetry-rhapsody.
translations.idiomatic: Then memorialists argued that with the two tracks divided and quotas unset, National University and prefectural quotas should be divided in thirds—two parts for classic elucidation and one for poetry-rhapsody.

sentences.zh: 若省試，則以累舉過省中數立為定額而分之。

translations.literal: For the metropolitan examination, fixed quotas should be based on cumulative passes at the metropolitan level and divided accordingly.
translations.idiomatic: For the metropolitan examination, fixed quotas should be based on the cumulative number of passes and divided accordingly.

sentences.zh: 詔下其議，然竟不果行。

translations.literal: The memorial was ordered debated but ultimately not implemented.
translations.idiomatic: The memorial was ordered debated but was ultimately not implemented.

sentences.zh: 孝宗初，詔川、廣進士之在行都者，令附試兩浙轉運司。

translations.literal: Early in Xiaozong's reign, Sichuan and Guang jinshi in the capital were ordered to take attached examinations at the Two Zhe transport commission.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Emperor Xiaozong's reign, Sichuan and Guang jinshi in the capital were ordered to take attached examinations at the Two Zhe transport commission.

sentences.zh: 隆興元年，禦試第一人承事郎、簽書諸州節度判官，第二第三人文林郎、兩使職官，第四第五人從事郎、初等職官，第六人至第四甲並迪功郎、諸州司戶簿尉，第五甲守選。

translations.literal: In the first year of Longxing, at the palace examination the first place received Assistant Master and signing secretary to military commissioners of all prefectures; second and third Literary Forest and two-envoy office; fourth and fifth Attendant Official and entry-level office; from sixth place through the fourth class all Merit Officer and prefectural revenue clerk or sheriff; fifth class awaited selection.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Longxing, at the palace examination the first place received Assistant Master and signing secretary to military commissioners of all prefectures; second and third received Literary Forest and a two-envoy office; fourth and fifth received Attendant Official and an entry-level office; from sixth place through the fourth class all received Merit Officer and a prefectural revenue clerk or sheriff post; the fifth class awaited selection.

sentences.zh: 乾道元年，詔四川特奏名第一等第一名賜同學究出身，第二名至本等末補將仕郎，第二等至第四等賜下州文學，第五等諸州助教。

translations.literal: In the first year of Qiandao an edict ordered that for Sichuan special listed candidates, first in the first grade received fellow student-scholar by origin; second through the end of that grade received Awaiting Office Gentleman; second through fourth grades received literary scholar of a lower prefecture; fifth grade prefectural assistant instructor.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Qiandao an edict ordered that for Sichuan special listed candidates, first in the first grade received fellow student-scholar by origin; second through the end of that grade received Awaiting Office Gentleman; second through fourth grades received literary scholar of a lower prefecture; and the fifth grade received prefectural assistant instructor.

sentences.zh: 二年，禦試，始推登極恩，第一名宣義郎，第二名與第一名恩例，第三名承事郎；

translations.literal: In the second year, at the palace examination, accession grace was first extended: first place Instructor in Righteousness; second place received the same favor as first; third place Assistant Master;
translations.idiomatic: In the second year, at the palace examination, accession grace was first extended: first place received Instructor in Righteousness; second received the same favor as first; third received Assistant Master;

sentences.zh: 第一甲賜進士及第並文林郎，第二甲賜進士及第並從事郎，第三、第四甲進士出身，第五甲同進士出身；

translations.literal: first class granted jinshi with honors and Literary Forest; second class jinshi with honors and Attendant Official; third and fourth classes jinshi by origin; fifth class fellow jinshi by origin;
translations.idiomatic: the first class received jinshi with honors and Literary Forest; the second class jinshi with honors and Attendant Official; the third and fourth classes jinshi by origin; the fifth class fellow jinshi by origin;

sentences.zh: 特奏名第一名賜進士出身，第二、第三名賜同進士出身。

translations.literal: special listed first place granted jinshi by origin; second and third fellow jinshi by origin.
translations.idiomatic: the leading special-listed candidate received jinshi by origin; second and third received fellow jinshi by origin.

sentences.zh: 四年，裁定牒試法：文武臣添差官除親子孫外並罷，其行在職事官除監察御史以上，餘並不許牒試。

translations.literal: In the fourth year the document examination law was fixed: for civil and military supernumerary appointees, except direct sons and grandsons, all were abolished; for officials on duty at the temporary court, except investigating censors and above, the rest were not permitted document examination.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year the document examination law was fixed: civil and military supernumerary appointees were abolished except for direct sons and grandsons; officials serving at the mobile court were not permitted document examination except investigating censors and above.

sentences.zh: 六年，詔諸道試官皆隔一郡選差，後又令曆三郡合符乃聽入院，防私弊也。

translations.literal: In the sixth year an edict ordered that circuit examiners be selected from one prefecture removed; later they were required to have served three prefectures in succession before entering the hall, to prevent private abuses.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year an edict ordered that circuit examiners be selected from a prefecture one remove away; later they were required to have served in three successive prefectures before entering the examination hall, to prevent private abuses.

sentences.zh: 帝欲令文士能射禦，武臣知詩書，命討論殿最之法。

translations.literal: The emperor wished civil scholars to be able to shoot in the imperial presence and military officers to know poetry and books; he ordered discussion of methods for ranking highest and lowest.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor wished civil scholars to be able to shoot in the imperial presence and military officers to know poetry and the classics; he ordered discussion of methods for ranking performance.

sentences.zh: 淳熙二年禦試，唱第後二日，御殿，引按文士詹騤以下一百三十九人射藝。

translations.literal: In the second year of Chunxi, at the palace examination, two days after names were announced the emperor mounted the hall and summoned one hundred thirty-nine civil scholars from Zhan Quan downward to demonstrate archery.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Chunxi, two days after names were announced at the palace examination, the emperor mounted the hall and summoned one hundred thirty-nine civil scholars from Zhan Quan downward to demonstrate archery.

sentences.zh: 翌日，又引文士第五甲及特奏名一百五十二人。

translations.literal: The next day another one hundred fifty-two from the fifth class and special listed candidates were summoned.
translations.idiomatic: The next day another one hundred fifty-two candidates from the fifth class and the special listed group were summoned.

sentences.zh: 其日，進士具襴笏入殿起居，易戎服，各給箭六，弓不限鬥力，射者莫不振厲自獻，多命中焉。

translations.literal: That day the jinshi, bearing ceremonial tablets, entered the hall for obeisance, changed into military dress, and each received six arrows; bow draw strength was not limited. None failed to exert themselves in presentation, and many hit the target.
translations.idiomatic: That day the jinshi entered the hall bearing ceremonial tablets, changed into military dress, and each received six arrows; bow draw strength was not limited. Every archer exerted himself, and many hit the target.

sentences.zh: 天子甚悅。

translations.literal: The Son of Heaven was greatly pleased.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor was greatly pleased.

sentences.zh: 凡三箭中帖為上等，正奏第一人轉一官，與通判，餘循一資；

translations.literal: In all, three arrows hitting the target sheet counted as upper grade: the first regular listed candidate was transferred one rank and given military commissioner; the rest advanced one step;
translations.idiomatic: Three arrows hitting the target sheet counted as the upper grade: the leading regular listed candidate was transferred one rank and given a military commissioner post; the rest advanced one step;

sentences.zh: 二箭中為中等，減二年磨勘；

translations.literal: two hits counted as middle grade, reducing merit review by two years;
translations.idiomatic: two hits counted as the middle grade and reduced merit review by two years;

sentences.zh: 一箭中帖及一箭上垛為下等，一任回不依次注官；

translations.literal: one hit on the sheet and one on the buttress counted as lower grade, with appointment not in regular order after one term;
translations.idiomatic: one hit on the sheet and one on the buttress counted as the lower grade, with appointment not in regular order after one term;

sentences.zh: 上四甲能全中者取旨；

translations.literal: those in the upper four classes who hit all targets received special imperial order;
translations.idiomatic: those in the upper four classes who hit every target received special imperial favor;

sentences.zh: 第五甲射入上等注黃甲，餘升名次而已。

translations.literal: fifth class archers who reached upper grade were placed in the yellow class; the rest merely advanced in rank order.
translations.idiomatic: fifth-class archers who reached the upper grade were placed in the yellow class; the rest merely advanced in rank order.

sentences.zh: 特奏名五等人射藝合格與文學，不中者亦賜帛。

translations.literal: Special listed candidates of the fifth grade who passed archery received literary scholar; those who failed still received silk.
translations.idiomatic: Special listed candidates of the fifth grade who passed archery received literary scholar; those who failed still received silk.

sentences.zh: 四年，罷同文館試。

translations.literal: In the fourth year the Tongwen Hall examination was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year the Tongwen Hall examination was abolished.

sentences.zh: 又命省試簾外官同姓異姓親若門客，亦依簾內官避親法，牒送別院。

translations.literal: It was also ordered that for metropolitan examination, outside-the-curtain officials' kin of the same or different surname, or retainers, should follow inside-the-curtain kin-avoidance law and be sent by document to a separate courtyard.
translations.idiomatic: It was also ordered that at the metropolitan examination, kin of the same or different surname, or retainers, of outside-the-curtain officials should follow the inside-the-curtain kin-avoidance law and be sent by document to a separate courtyard.

sentences.zh: 五年，以階、成、西和、鳳州正奏名比附特奏名五路人例，特升一甲。

translations.literal: In the fifth year regular listed candidates from Jie, Cheng, Xihe, and Feng Prefectures were compared to the five-circuit special listed precedent and specially raised one class.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year regular listed candidates from Jie, Cheng, Xihe, and Feng prefectures were treated by analogy to the five-circuit special listed precedent and specially raised one class.

sentences.zh: 六年，詔特奏名自今三名取一，寘第四等以前，餘並入第五等，其末等納敕者止許一次，潛藩及五路舊升甲者今但升名。

translations.literal: In the sixth year an edict ordered that for special listed candidates from now on one in three would be taken and placed before the fourth grade; the rest all entered the fifth grade. Those in the lowest grade who submitted edicts were permitted only once; former class promotions for hidden fiefs and the five circuits now advanced only in name.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year an edict ordered that for special listed candidates one in three would be taken and placed before the fourth grade; the rest would enter the fifth grade. Those in the lowest grade who submitted edicts were permitted only once; former class promotions for hidden fiefs and the five circuits now advanced only in name.

sentences.zh: 其後又許納敕三次，為定制焉。

translations.literal: Later submission of edicts three times was permitted, and this became fixed regulation.
translations.idiomatic: Later, submission of edicts three times was permitted, and this became fixed practice.

sentences.zh: 十一年，進士廷試不許見燭，其納卷最後者降黜之。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year jinshi at the court examination were not permitted to see candles; those who submitted papers last were demoted.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year jinshi at the court examination were not permitted candles; those who submitted papers last were demoted.

sentences.zh: 舊制，廷試至暮許賜燭，然殿深易暗，日昃已燭出矣。

translations.literal: Under the old system, court examination until evening permitted granting candles; yet the hall was deep and easily dark, and by mid-afternoon candles were already out.
translations.idiomatic: Under the old system the court examination permitted candles until evening; yet the hall was deep and easily dark, and by mid-afternoon candles were already issued.

sentences.zh: 凡賜燭，正奏名降一甲，第五甲降充本甲末名；

translations.literal: Whenever candles were granted, regular listed candidates were lowered one class; fifth class candidates were lowered to last place in their class;
translations.idiomatic: Whenever candles were granted, regular listed candidates were lowered one class; fifth-class candidates were lowered to last place in their class;

sentences.zh: 特奏名降一等，第五等與攝助教。

translations.literal: special listed candidates lowered one grade; fifth grade received acting assistant instructor.
translations.idiomatic: special listed candidates were lowered one grade; the fifth grade received acting assistant instructor.

sentences.zh: 凡試藝於省闈及國子監、兩浙轉運司者，皆禁燭，其他郡國，率達旦乃出。

translations.literal: All who tested at the provincial gate, Directorate of Education, or Two Zhe transport commission were forbidden candles; in other prefectures and states they generally left only at dawn.
translations.idiomatic: All who tested at the provincial examination hall, the Directorate of Education, or the Two Zhe transport commission were forbidden candles; in other prefectures and circuits they generally left only at dawn.

sentences.zh: 十月，太常博士倪思言：「舉人輕視史學，今之論史者獨取漢、唐混一之事，三國、六朝、五代為非盛世而恥談之，然其進取之得失，守禦之當否，籌策之疏密，區處兵民之方，形勢成敗之跡，俾加討究，有補國家。

translations.literal: In the tenth month Erudite of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices Ni Si said: "Candidates slight historical learning. Today's historians take only Han and Tang unification; they are ashamed to discuss the Three Kingdoms, Six Dynasties, and Five Dynasties as non-golden ages—yet their advances and retreats, the rightness of defense, the density of strategy, methods for managing troops and people, and traces of success and failure, if studied further, would benefit the state.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month Erudite of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices Ni Si said, "Candidates slight historical learning. Today's historians discuss only Han and Tang unification and are ashamed to treat the Three Kingdoms, Six Dynasties, and Five Dynasties as golden ages—yet their advances and retreats, the soundness of defense, the density of strategy, methods for managing troops and people, and the traces of success and failure, if studied further, would benefit the state.

sentences.zh: 請諭春官：凡課試命題，雜出諸史，無所拘忌；

translations.literal: I request instructing the Ministry of Rites: in all examination questions draw from various histories without restriction;
translations.idiomatic: I ask that the Ministry of Rites be instructed that all examination questions should draw from various histories without restriction;

sentences.zh: 考核之際，稍以論策為重，毋止以初場定去留。」

translations.literal: at evaluation give somewhat more weight to discourses and policy questions, and do not decide solely by the first session."
translations.idiomatic: at evaluation give somewhat more weight to discourses and policy questions, and do not decide admission solely by the first session."

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: This was approved.
translations.idiomatic: This was approved.

sentences.zh: 十四年，禦試正奏名王容第一。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year at the palace examination regular listed candidate Wang Rong placed first.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year at the palace examination regular listed candidate Wang Rong placed first.

sentences.zh: 時帝策士，不盡由有司，是舉容本第三，親擢為榜首。

translations.literal: At that time the emperor examined scholars and did not wholly rely on officials; in this examination Rong had originally been third but was personally raised to top place.
translations.idiomatic: At that time the emperor examined scholars and did not wholly rely on officials; in this examination Rong had originally been third but was personally raised to first place.

sentences.zh: 翰林學士洪邁言：「 《貢舉令》：賦限三百六十字，論限五百字。

translations.literal: Hanlin Academician Hong Mai said: "The Statutes on Recommendation and Examination limit rhapsody to three hundred sixty characters and discourse to five hundred.
translations.idiomatic: Hanlin Academician Hong Mai said, "The Statutes on Recommendation and Examination limit rhapsody to three hundred sixty characters and discourse to five hundred.

sentences.zh: 今經義、論、策一道有至三千言，賦一篇幾六百言，寸晷之下，唯務貪多，累牘連篇，何由精妙？

translations.literal: Now one classic elucidation, discourse, or policy question reaches three thousand characters; one rhapsody nearly six hundred. Under the pressure of a short measure of time they only strive to be lengthy—sheets piled page on page—how can there be refinement?
translations.idiomatic: Now one classic elucidation, discourse, or policy question reaches three thousand characters, and one rhapsody nearly six hundred. Under the pressure of a short measure of time candidates only strive to be lengthy—sheets piled page on page—how can there be refinement?

sentences.zh: 宜俾各遵體格，以返渾淳。」

translations.literal: They should each follow the proper form to return to simplicity."
translations.idiomatic: They should each follow the proper form to return to simplicity."

sentences.zh: 時朱熹嘗欲罷詩賦，而分諸經、子、史、時務之年。

translations.literal: At that time Zhu Xi had wished to abolish poetry and rhapsody and divide the years among classics, masters, histories, and current affairs.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Zhu Xi had wished to abolish poetry and rhapsody and divide the examination years among classics, masters, histories, and current affairs.

sentences.zh: 其《私議》曰：「古者大學之教，以格物致知為先，而其考校之法，又以九年知類通達、強立不反為大成。

translations.literal: His Private Discourse states: "In antiquity the teaching of the Great Learning put investigating things and extending knowledge first, and its method of examination took nine years' knowledge of categories, penetration, firm establishment without reversal as full completion.
translations.idiomatic: His Private Discourse states, "In antiquity the teaching of the Great Learning put investigating things and extending knowledge first, and its method of examination took nine years' knowledge of categories, penetration, and firm establishment without reversal as full completion.

sentences.zh: 今《樂經》亡而《禮經》闕，二戴之《禮》已非正經，而又廢其一。

translations.literal: Now the Classic of Music is lost and the Classic of Rites is deficient; the Rites of the two Dai are already not orthodox classics, and one of them is further abandoned.
translations.idiomatic: Now the Classic of Music is lost and the Classic of Rites is deficient; the Rites of the two Dai are no longer orthodox classics, and one of them is further abandoned.

sentences.zh: 經之為教已不能備，而治經者類皆舍其所難而就其易，僅窺其一而不及其餘。

translations.literal: Teaching through the classics can no longer be complete, and those who study classics generally abandon what is difficult and take what is easy, merely glimpsing one and not reaching the rest.
translations.idiomatic: Teaching through the classics can no longer be complete, and those who study classics generally abandon what is difficult and take what is easy, merely glimpsing one and not reaching the rest.

sentences.zh: 若諸子之學同出於聖人，諸史則該古今興亡治亂得失之變，皆不可闕者。

translations.literal: The learning of the various masters likewise derives from the sages; the various histories encompass the changes of rise and fall, order and disorder, gain and loss in past and present—all indispensable.
translations.idiomatic: The learning of the various masters likewise derives from the sages; the various histories encompass the changes of rise and fall, order and disorder, gain and loss in past and present—all indispensable.

sentences.zh: 而學者一旦豈能盡通？

translations.literal: Yet how can scholars master all at once?
translations.idiomatic: Yet how can scholars master all at once?

sentences.zh: 若合所當讀之書而分之以年，使之各以三年而共通其三四之一。

translations.literal: If the books that should be read are combined and divided by year, so that in three years each commonly masters three or four parts of one.
translations.idiomatic: If the books that should be read are combined and divided by year, so that in three years each commonly masters three or four parts of one track.

sentences.zh: 凡《易》、《詩》、《書》為一科，而子年、午年試之；

translations.literal: The Changes, Odes, and Documents form one track, examined in zi and wu years;
translations.idiomatic: The Changes, Odes, and Documents would form one track, examined in zi and wu years;

sentences.zh: 《周禮》、《儀禮》及二《戴記》為一科，而卯年試之；

translations.literal: the Rites of Zhou, Etiquette and Ceremonial, and the two Dai Records form one track, examined in mao years;
translations.idiomatic: the Rites of Zhou, Etiquette and Ceremonial, and the two Dai Records would form one track, examined in mao years;

sentences.zh: 《春秋》及《三傳》為一科，而酉年試之。

translations.literal: the Spring and Autumn Annals and the Three Commentaries form one track, examined in you years.
