translations.idiomatic: the Spring and Autumn Annals and the Three Commentaries would form one track, examined in you years.

sentences.zh: 義各二道，諸經皆兼《大學》、《論語》、《中庸》、《孟子》義一道。

translations.literal: Two elucidation questions each; all classics also include one question on the Great Learning, Analects, Doctrine of the Mean, and Mencius.
translations.idiomatic: There would be two elucidation questions each; all classics would also include one question on the Great Learning, Analects, Doctrine of the Mean, and Mencius.

sentences.zh: 論則分諸子為四科，而分年以附焉。

translations.literal: Discourses would divide the masters into four tracks, attached to years in sequence.
translations.idiomatic: Discourses would divide the masters into four tracks, attached to years in sequence.

sentences.zh: 諸史則《左傳》、《國語》、《史記》、《兩漢》為一科，《三國》、《晉書》、《南北史》為一科，《新舊唐書》、《五代史》為一科。

translations.literal: Histories: the Zuo Commentary, Discourses of the States, Records of the Grand Historian, and the two Han form one track; the Three Kingdoms, Book of Jin, and Northern and Southern Histories another; the New and Old Books of Tang and History of the Five Dynasties another.
translations.idiomatic: For histories, the Zuo Commentary, Discourses of the States, Records of the Grand Historian, and the two Han would form one track; the Three Kingdoms, Book of Jin, and Northern and Southern Histories another; and the New and Old Books of Tang and History of the Five Dynasties another.

sentences.zh: 時務則律曆、地理為一科，以次分年如經、子之法，試策各二道。

translations.literal: Current affairs: calendrical astronomy and geography form one track, divided by year in sequence like classics and masters; two policy questions each.
translations.idiomatic: For current affairs, calendrical astronomy and geography would form one track, divided by year in sequence like classics and masters, with two policy questions each.

translations.idiomatic: Those studying classics would each maintain his school's method; those answering elucidation must penetrate the classic text, list various doctrines, and decide by their own judgment; officials setting questions must follow chapter and sentence—thus scholars would master classics and histories alike and all could serve the world."

sentences.zh: 其議雖未上，而天下誦之。

translations.idiomatic: Though this proposal was never submitted, it was recited throughout the realm.

translations.idiomatic: Early in Emperor Guangzong's reign, because the metropolitan examination in early spring was still cold, it was extended to an auspicious day in the second month, with the palace examination in the first ten days of the fourth month.

translations.literal: In the first year of Shaoxi archery was still required; those who failed were denied silk.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Shaoxi archery was still required; those who failed were denied silk.

sentences.zh: 舊命官鎖廳及避親舉人同試。

translations.literal: Formerly incumbent officials in locked chambers and kin-avoidance candidates were examined together.
translations.idiomatic: Formerly incumbent officials in locked chambers and kin-avoidance candidates were examined together.

sentences.zh: 三年，始令分場，以革假人試藝者，於是四蜀皆然。

translations.literal: In the third year separate examination grounds were first ordered to reform those who used proxies to test; thereafter all four Shu regions did likewise.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year separate examination grounds were first ordered to stop proxy examinees; thereafter all four Shu regions did likewise.

sentences.zh: 寧宗慶元二年，韓侂胄襲秦檜餘論，指道學為偽學，台臣附和之，上章論列。

translations.literal: In the second year of Qingyuan under Ningzong, Han Tuozhou adopted Qin Hui's remaining arguments, labeled the Learning of the Way as false learning, and censorial officials echoed him, submitting memorials enumerating offenders.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Qingyuan under Emperor Ningzong, Han Tuozhou adopted Qin Hui's remaining arguments, labeled the Learning of the Way as false learning, and censorial officials echoed him with memorials enumerating offenders.

sentences.zh: 劉德秀在省闈，奏請毀除語錄。

translations.literal: Liu Dexiu at the provincial gate memorialized requesting destruction of recorded sayings.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Dexiu at the provincial examination memorialized requesting destruction of recorded sayings.

sentences.zh: 既而知貢舉吏部尚書葉翥上言：「士狃於偽學，專習語錄詭誕之說、《中庸》《大學》之書，以文其非。

translations.idiomatic: Then Chief Examination Officer, Minister of Personnel Ye Zhi memorialized, "Scholars are addicted to false learning, specializing in the bizarre doctrines of recorded sayings and the books Doctrine of the Mean and Great Learning to ornament their errors.

sentences.zh: 有葉適《進卷》、陳傅良《待遇集》，士人傳誦其文，每用輒效。

translations.literal: There are Ye Shi's Memorials and Chen Fuliang's Collection on Treatment; scholars transmit and recite them, imitating them whenever used.
translations.idiomatic: There are Ye Shi's Memorials and Chen Fuliang's Collection on Treatment; scholars transmit and recite them and imitate them whenever they write.

sentences.zh: 請令太學及州軍學，各以月試合格前三名程文，上御史臺考察，太學以月，諸路以季。

translations.literal: I request ordering the Imperial University and prefectural and army-command schools each to submit the top three monthly examination papers to the Censorate for inspection—the university monthly, the circuits quarterly.
translations.idiomatic: I ask that the Imperial University and prefectural and army-command schools each submit the top three monthly examination papers to the Censorate for inspection—the university monthly, the circuits quarterly.

translations.idiomatic: In this examination all whose language touched the Learning of the Way were excluded from selection.

translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, because classic elucidation widely used formulaic categories transmitted from father to son and brother to brother, scholars throughout the realm neglected solid learning.

translations.idiomatic: Officials were ordered that for the six classics, in each classic two passages of similar meaning should be selected and combined as one question, to block cheating by bringing books.

translations.idiomatic: In Jiatai year 1, Diary Attendant Zhang Liangneng set out three faults of the chief examiners: “First, they suppress poetry and rhapsody too severely; they both secretly reduce the scores and often place them in the lower ranks.

translations.literal: Second, they rely on the Spring and Autumn Annals too excessively, and in the preliminary lists in many places they often put such candidates in first selection.
translations.idiomatic: Second, they rely on the Spring and Autumn Annals too excessively, and in the preliminary lists in many places they often put such candidates in first selection.

translations.idiomatic: It was ordered that henceforth those whose poetry and rhapsody were pure and correct be placed in the front ranks; for the Spring and Autumn Annals, only those exceptionally outstanding were to be placed in the higher grades, while the rest should be mixed in judgment; policy questions had to ask clearly and plainly.

translations.idiomatic: In year 4, an edict declared, “From now on, for persons barred by status regulations and those not barred who are examined at transport offices, separate halls and different questions shall be used; this shall forever be the fixed system.”

translations.idiomatic: Do not select people by a fragment or a single word.

sentences.zh: 舊制，秋貢春試，皆置別頭場，以待舉人之避親者。

translations.literal: Old system, autumn tribute spring examination, all established separate-track grounds, to await candidates avoiding kin.
translations.idiomatic: Under the old system, autumn tribute and spring examinations each had a separate-track session for candidates avoiding kin.

sentences.zh: 自緦麻以上親及大功以上婚姻之家，皆牒送。

translations.literal: From three-months-mourning and above kin and greater-merit-mourning and above marriage families, all memorandum sent.
translations.idiomatic: Relatives within three-months mourning and affinal kin within greater merit mourning were all reported by memorandum.

translations.literal: Only imperial hall audience examination, called Son of Heaven's own disciples, although father elder brother as examiners, also not avoid.
translations.idiomatic: Only the imperial hall audience examination, called the emperor's own disciples, did not require avoidance even when fathers or elder brothers served as examiners.

translations.literal: Jiading first year, beginning because memorialist had request, ordered court officials having kin attending palace audience, exempted assignment as examiners.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Jiading, beginning with a memorialist's request, court officials whose kin were taking the palace audience were excused from appointment as examiners.

translations.literal: Twelfth year, ordered Imperial University document examination, forbade false claiming collateral lineage, shifting mourning grades, violators certainly placed in punishment.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year, Imperial University document examinations were ordered: false claims of collateral lineage and shifting mourning grades were forbidden; violators would certainly be penalized.

translations.idiomatic: The court approved.

translations.idiomatic: By the reign of Emperor Lizong, fraud had grown worse.

translations.idiomatic: Examinee abuses numbered five: passing prepared answers, switching papers, changing registration numbers, papers taken outside the grounds, and sloppy transcription.

sentences.zh: 入試日，一切不許傳遞。

translations.literal: On examination entry day, all not permit passing messages.
translations.idiomatic: On the day of entry, all passing of messages should be forbidden.

sentences.zh: 門禁既嚴，則數弊自清。

translations.literal: Gate restrictions since strict, then several abuses naturally clear.
translations.idiomatic: Once gate security is strict, several abuses will clear themselves.

sentences.zh: 士人暮夜納卷，易於散失。

translations.literal: Scholars evening night submit papers, easy to lose scattered.
translations.idiomatic: When scholars submitted papers at night, they were easily lost.

translations.literal: Should order sealing officials personally seal lock paper chests, scholars personally write curtain registers deposit in chests.
translations.idiomatic: Sealing officials should personally lock the paper chests; scholars should personally write their names on curtain registers and deposit them in the chests.

translations.idiomatic: Only after all candidates had left the compound should the chests be opened, papers classified and copied, and then sent to the transcription office.

translations.literal: Next dawn, report each session name counts to Censorate for verification.
translations.idiomatic: The next morning, report the name counts for each session to the Censorate for verification.

translations.literal: Transcription persons select copyists to fill, not permit substitute names, provide surname given name character samples, report compound copy-verify inspect true.
translations.idiomatic: Transcription clerks should be selected copyists; proxy names are forbidden; surname, given name, and handwriting samples should be submitted to the compound for copying and verification.

sentences.zh: 傳義置窠之人，委臨安府嚴捕。

translations.literal: Those passing prepared answers who set nests, entrusted Lin'an Prefecture strictly arrest.
translations.idiomatic: Those who passed prepared answers and set up nests for them were entrusted to Lin'an Prefecture for strict arrest.

sentences.zh: 其考官容情任意者，許台諫風聞彈奏，重寘典憲。

translations.literal: Those examiners indulging feelings at will, permit censorate remonstrance hearsay impeachment, heavily place in statutes.
translations.idiomatic: Examiners who indulged candidates at will might be impeached on hearsay by the censorate and heavily punished under statute.

translations.idiomatic: The emperor approved all of this and also ordered examiners to be carefully chosen and old habits not followed.

translations.literal: Household registers each write native place, not ask where they come from, and fix its name "lodging examination," with forty names as quota, if examine reaching full fifty persons, then temporarily obtain imperial decision increase release.
translations.idiomatic: Household registers recorded native place regardless of origin, and the name was fixed as "lodging examination," with a quota of forty; if fifty presented themselves, temporary imperial approval could increase the quota.

sentences.zh: 又罷諸路轉運司及諸州軍府所取待補國子生，自明年並許赴國子監混試。

translations.literal: Again abolished all circuit transport commissions and all prefecture army-command offices' selected awaiting-supplement Imperial University students, from next year all permitted go Imperial University mixed examination.
translations.idiomatic: Selection of Imperial University students awaiting supplement by circuit transport commissions and prefectural and army-command offices was also abolished; from the next year all might take the mixed examination at the Imperial University.

sentences.zh: 以士子數多，命於禮部及臨安轉運司兩試院外，紹興、安吉各置一院，從朝廷差官前詣，同日引試，分各路士人就試焉。

translations.literal: Because scholar count many, ordered at Ministry of Rites and Lin'an transport commission two examination compounds outside, Shaoxing Anji each establish one compound, follow court assign officials go beforehand, same day summon examine, divide each circuit scholars go examine there.
translations.idiomatic: Because candidates were numerous, beyond the two compounds at the Ministry of Rites and the Lin'an transport commission one compound each was established at Shaoxing and Anji; court-assigned officials went in advance, examinations were held the same day, and scholars of each circuit examined there.

sentences.zh: 同在京，不許見燭。

translations.literal: Same at capital, not permit see candles.
translations.idiomatic: As at the capital, candles were not permitted.

sentences.zh: 是年，已失京西諸州軍，士多徙寓江陵、鄂州，命京湖製置司於江陵別立貢院，取德安府、荊門軍、歸峽復三州及隨、郢、均、房等京西七郡士人，別差官混試，用十二郡元額混取以優之。

translations.literal: This year, already lost Capital West various prefectures armies, scholars many moved lodge Jiangling Ezhou, ordered Capital-Huai Pacification Commission at Jiangling separately establish tribute compound, take De'an Prefecture Jingmen Army Gui Xia Fu three prefectures and Sui Ying Jun Fang etc Capital West seven commanderies scholars, separately assign officials mixed examine, use twelve commanderies original quotas mixed select to favor them.
translations.idiomatic: That year the Capital West prefectures and army commands had been lost and many scholars had moved to Jiangling and Ezhou; the Capital-Huai Pacification Commission was ordered to establish a separate tribute compound at Jiangling for scholars of De'an Prefecture, Jingmen Army, the three recovered prefectures of Gui, Xia, and Fu, and the seven Capital West commanderies including Sui, Ying, Jun, and Fang; separate officials were assigned for a mixed examination, selecting by the combined original quotas of twelve commanderies to favor them.

sentences.zh: 牒試既罷，又復冒求國子，士大夫為子弟計者，輒牒外方他族，利為場屋相資，或公然受價以鬻。

translations.literal: Document examination since abolished, again falsely sought Imperial University, scholar-officials planning for sons and younger kin, then document outer regions other clans, profit as examination grounds mutual aid, or openly receive price to sell.
translations.idiomatic: After document examination was abolished, false claims to the Imperial University revived: scholar-officials scheming for sons and younger kin documented other clans in distant regions for mutual aid at the examination grounds, or openly took payment to sell the privilege.

sentences.zh: 命遍諭百官司知雜司等：如已準朝廷辨驗，批書印紙，批下國子監收試，即報赴試人躬赴監。

translations.literal: Ordered broadly instruct all hundred offices miscellaneous affairs offices etc: if already approved court verification, annotate stamped paper, annotate down Imperial University receive examination, then report examinee personally go to university.
translations.idiomatic: All offices including miscellaneous affairs offices were instructed: once court verification was approved and stamped papers annotated for the Imperial University to receive the examination, the examinee must be reported to appear in person at the university.

sentences.zh: 一姓結為一保，每保不過十人，責立罪罰，當官書押，遞相委保，各給告示，方許投納試卷。

translations.literal: One surname formed one guarantee group, each group not exceed ten persons, charge establish penal oath, incumbent official sign seal, mutually entrust guarantee, each given notice, then permit submit examination papers.
translations.idiomatic: One surname formed one guarantee group of no more than ten; penal oaths were required and incumbent officials signed; mutual guarantees were established and notices issued before papers might be submitted.

sentences.zh: 冒牒官降官罷任，或一時失於參照，誤牒他族，計自陳悔牒一次。

translations.literal: False documenting officials demoted dismissed office, or momentarily failed reference, mistakenly documented other clan, count self-report repent document once.
translations.idiomatic: Officials who falsely documented were demoted and dismissed; if through momentary failure of reference another clan was mistakenly documented, self-report and repentance of the document were counted once.

sentences.zh: 冒牒中選之人，限主保官、舉人一月自首，舉人駁放，主保官免罪；

translations.literal: False document selected persons, limit chief guarantor official examinee one month self-report, examinee struck dismiss, chief guarantor official exempt punishment;
translations.idiomatic: Those falsely documented who had been selected were given one month for chief guarantor and examinee to confess; the examinee was struck off and the chief guarantor exempted;

sentences.zh: 出限不首者，仍照前條罪之。

translations.literal: beyond limit not report, still follow previous article punish.
translations.idiomatic: those who did not report within the limit were still punished under the previous article.

sentences.zh: 凡類試卷，封彌作弊不一。

translations.literal: Whenever classified examination papers, sealing-name fraud not uniform.
translations.idiomatic: In classified examinations, sealing-name fraud took many forms.

sentences.zh: 至是，命前期於兩浙轉運司、臨安府選見役吏胥共三十人，差近上一名部轄入院，十名專管詩賦，餘分管諸經。

translations.literal: At this time, ordered beforehand at Liangzhe transport commission Lin'an Prefecture select current clerks thirty persons, assign one senior section chief enter compound, ten exclusively manage poetry-rhapsody, remainder separately manage various classics.
translations.idiomatic: Thirty current clerks were selected beforehand from the Liangzhe transport commission and Lin'an Prefecture; one senior section chief entered the compound, ten managed poetry and rhapsody exclusively, and the rest managed the various classics.

sentences.zh: 各隨所管號，於引試之夕，分尋試卷，各置簿封彌，不許混亂；

translations.literal: Each follow managed numbers, on summon-examination evening, separately seek examination papers, each set register seal-name, not permit mix confusion;
translations.idiomatic: Each followed the numbers under his charge; on the evening of the examination they separately collected papers, each kept a sealing register, and mixing was forbidden;

sentences.zh: 卻別差一吏將號置曆，發過謄錄所書寫。

translations.literal: yet separately assigned one clerk take numbers set register, send to transcription office write.
translations.idiomatic: another clerk was assigned to take the numbers register and send it to the transcription office for copying.

sentences.zh: 其簿、曆，封彌官收掌，不經吏手，不許謄錄人干預，以革其弊。

translations.literal: Its registers, ledgers, sealing-name officials receive keep, not pass clerk hands, not permit transcription persons intervene, to reform its abuses.
translations.idiomatic: Registers and ledgers were kept by sealing officials without passing through clerks' hands; transcription clerks might not intervene, to reform the abuse.

sentences.zh: 二年，省試下第及遊學人，並就臨安府給據，赴兩浙轉運司混試待補太學生。

translations.literal: Second year, metropolitan examination failed candidates and traveling scholars, all at Lin'an Prefecture issue credentials, go Liangzhe transport commission mixed examine awaiting-supplement Imperial University students.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year, those who failed the metropolitan examination and traveling scholars alike received credentials from Lin'an Prefecture and took the mixed examination at the Liangzhe transport commission for students awaiting supplement to the Imperial University.

sentences.zh: 臣僚言：「國子牒試之弊，冒濫滋甚。

translations.literal: Officials said: "Imperial University document examination abuses, false overflow grew more severe.
translations.idiomatic: Officials said, "The abuses of Imperial University document examination have grown worse through false claims.

sentences.zh: 在朝之士，有強認疏遠之親為近屬者，有各私親故換易而互牒者，有為權勢所軋、人情所牽應命而泛及者，有自揆子弟非才、牒同姓之雋茂利其假手者，有文藝素乏、執格法以求牒轉售同姓以謀利者。

translations.literal: Court scholars, some forcibly claimed distant kin as close kin, some each privately kin friends exchange and mutual document, some compelled by power pressured by human feelings respond order broadly extend, some self-judge sons younger kin not talented document same-surname outstanding profit their borrowed hand, some literary arts always deficient hold regulations seek document resell same-surname to seek profit.
translations.idiomatic: Among court scholars, some forcibly claimed distant kin as close kin; some privately exchanged kin ties and documented one another; some, pressed by power or human obligation, broadly extended documentation; some, knowing their sons lacked talent, documented outstanding men of the same surname to borrow their hands; some, always deficient in literary skill, used regulations to obtain documents and resell them within the clan for profit.

sentences.zh: 今後令牒官各從本職長官具朝典狀保明，先期取本官知委狀，仍立賞格，許人指實陳首。

translations.literal: Hereafter order documenting officials each follow their office chief prepare court-standard guarantee, beforehand obtain their official knowledge-delegation statement, still establish reward scale, permit people point out truth report.
translations.idiomatic: Henceforth documenting officials must have their office chiefs prepare court-standard guarantees and beforehand obtain knowledge-delegation statements; reward scales were established and truthful reporting permitted.

sentences.zh: 冒牒之官，按劾鐫秩；

translations.literal: False documenting officials, investigate impeach engrave rank;
translations.idiomatic: Officials who falsely documented were investigated, impeached, and demoted;

sentences.zh: 受牒之人，駁放殿舉；

translations.literal: those receiving documents, struck dismiss palace examination;
translations.idiomatic: those who received false documents were struck off from the palace examination;

sentences.zh: 保官亦與連坐。

translations.literal: guarantee officials also collectively punished.
translations.idiomatic: guarantee officials were punished collectively.

sentences.zh: 專令御史臺覺察，都省勘會。

translations.literal: Specially ordered Censorate observe, Chief Secretariat investigate.
translations.idiomatic: The Censorate was specially charged to observe and the Chief Secretariat to investigate.

sentences.zh: 類申門客、滿裏子孫仍前漕試，六十人取一，較之他處雖甚優，而取無定額，士有疑心，就試者少。

translations.literal: Classified-submit retainers full-village descendants still previous transport examination, sixty take one, compared other places although very favorable, yet select no fixed quota, scholars have suspicion, those examining few.
translations.idiomatic: Classified-submit retainers and full-village descendants still took the transport examination at one in sixty—favorable compared with elsewhere—but with no fixed quota scholars were doubtful and few presented themselves.

sentences.zh: 宜令額寬而試者眾，塗一而取之精。」

translations.literal: Should order quota wide and examinees many, one path select them refined."
translations.idiomatic: The quota should be broad and examinees numerous so that one in many might be selected with refinement."

sentences.zh: 遂依前例放行寓試，以四十名為定額，仍前待補；

translations.literal: Therefore followed previous example release lodging examination, with forty names as fixed quota, still previous awaiting supplement;
translations.idiomatic: Lodging examination was released as before with a fixed quota of forty and the previous awaiting-supplement rule;

sentences.zh: 其類申門客、滿裏子孫及附試並罷。

translations.literal: its classified-submit retainers full-village descendants and attached examination all abolished.
translations.idiomatic: classified-submit retainers, full-village descendants, and attached examination were all abolished.

sentences.zh: 淳祐元年，臣僚言：「既復諸路漕試，合國子試、兩項科舉及免舉人，不下千數。

translations.literal: Chunyou first year, officials said: "Since restored all circuits transport examination, combined Imperial University examination, two categories recruitment and exempt candidates, not below thousand count.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Chunyou officials said, "With circuit transport examinations restored, together with the Imperial University examination, the two recruitment categories, and exempt candidates, the total is no less than a thousand.

sentences.zh: 宜復撥漕舉、胄舉同避親人並就別院引試，使大院無卷冗之患，小院無額窄之弊。」

translations.literal: Should again assign transport examination collateral examination with kin-avoidance persons together at separate compound summon examine, cause great compound no paper excess trouble, small compound no quota narrow abuse."
translations.idiomatic: Transport-examination, collateral-examination, and kin-avoidance candidates should again be assigned to the separate compound so the great compound has no excess of papers and the small compound no narrow quota."

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: Approved.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved.

sentences.zh: 時淮南諸州郡歲有兵禍，士子不得以時赴鄉試，且漕司分差試官，路梗不可徑達。

translations.literal: At that time Huainan various prefectures yearly had military disasters, scholars could not at time attend prefectural examination, and transport commission divided assign examiners, roads blocked could not directly reach.
translations.idiomatic: Huainan prefectures yearly suffered military disasters; scholars could not attend prefectural examinations on time, and when transport commissions assigned examiners roads were blocked and they could not arrive.

sentences.zh: 三年，命淮東州郡附鎮江府秋試，淮西州郡附建康試，蘄黃光三州、安慶府附江州試。

translations.literal: Third year, ordered Huaidong prefectures attach Zhenjiang Prefecture autumn examination, Huaixi prefectures attach Jiankang examination, Qi Huang Guang three prefectures Anqing Prefecture attach Jiangzhou examination.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year Huaidong prefectures were attached to Zhenjiang Prefecture's autumn examination, Huaixi prefectures to Jiankang's examination, and Qi, Huang, Guang, and Anqing to Jiangzhou's examination.

sentences.zh: 三試所各增差試官二員，別項考校，照各州元額取放。

translations.literal: Three examination sites each added assign examiners two, separate item examine grade, follow each prefecture original quota select release.
translations.idiomatic: Each of the three examination sites gained two additional examiners for separate grading according to each prefecture's original quota.

sentences.zh: 是歲，兩浙轉運司寓試終場滿五千人，特命增放二名，後雖多不增，如不及五千人，止依元額。

translations.literal: This year, Liangzhe transport commission lodging examination final session full five thousand persons, specially ordered increase release two names, later although many not increase, if not reach five thousand, only follow original quota.
translations.idiomatic: That year the Liangzhe transport commission lodging examination had five thousand completing the final session and two additional places were specially granted; later increases were rare, and if fewer than five thousand completed, only the original quota applied.

sentences.zh: 別院之試，大率士子與試官實有親嫌者，紹定間，以漕試、胄試無親可避者亦許試，或謂時相徇於勢要子弟故也；

translations.literal: Separate compound examination, mostly scholars and examiners truly had kin conflict, Shaoding period, because transport examination collateral examination no kin to avoid also permitted examine, some said chief minister indulged powerful families' sons and younger kin therefore;
translations.idiomatic: Separate-compound examination was mostly for scholars and examiners with real kin conflicts; in the Shaoding era transport and collateral candidates with no kin to avoid were also permitted—some said the chief minister indulged powerful families' sons;

sentences.zh: 端平初，撥歸大院，寒雋便之；

translations.literal: Duanping beginning, assigned return great compound, poor talented benefited;
translations.idiomatic: early in Duanping they were returned to the great compound, which benefited poor talented scholars;

sentences.zh: 淳祐元年，又復赴別院，是使不應避親之人抑而就此，使天下士子無故析而為二，殊失別試之初意。

translations.literal: Chunyou first year, again returned to separate compound, this caused those who should not avoid kin suppressed to go there, caused realm scholars without reason divided into two, greatly lost separate examination's original intent.
translations.idiomatic: in the first year of Chunyou they were again sent to the separate compound, forcing those who need not avoid kin there and splitting scholars nationwide without cause, greatly losing the original intent of separate examination.

sentences.zh: 至是，依端平厘正之，復歸大院。

translations.literal: At this time, followed Duanping rectify it, again returned great compound.
translations.idiomatic: At this time, following Duanping's correction, they were returned to the great compound.

sentences.zh: 九年，以臣僚言：「士子又有免解偽冒入試者，或父兄沒而竊代其名，或同族物故而填其籍。」

translations.literal: Ninth year, because officials said: "Scholars again have exempt-send-up false impersonation enter examination, or fathers elder brothers died yet secretly substitute their names, or same clan deceased yet fill their register."
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year officials said: "Scholars also falsely impersonate exempt send-up candidates—some substitute names after fathers or elder brothers die, some fill registers after clansmen die."

sentences.zh: 於是令自本貫保明給據，類其姓名先申禮部，各州揭以示眾，犯者許告捉，依鬻舉法治罪。

translations.literal: Therefore ordered from native place guarantee issue credentials, classify their names first report Ministry of Rites, each prefecture post to show public, violators permit report arrest, follow selling-examination law punish.
translations.idiomatic: Credentials were to be issued with guarantee from the native place, names classified and reported first to the Ministry of Rites, and each prefecture was to post the list publicly; violators might be reported and punished under the law on selling examination places.

sentences.zh: 十二年，廣南西路言：「所部二十五郡，科選於春官者僅一二，蓋山林質樸，不能與中土士子同工，請授兩淮、荊襄例別考。」

translations.literal: Twelfth year, Guangnan West Circuit said: "Subordinate twenty-five commanderies, examination selection at Spring Office only one two, because mountain forest plain simple, cannot with central land scholars same work, request grant Lianghuai Jingxiang precedent separate examine."
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year the Guangnan West Circuit said: "Of twenty-five subordinate commanderies only one or two reach the Ministry of Rites examination; mountain folk are plain and cannot compete with central scholars—please grant separate examination as in Lianghuai and Jingxiang."

sentences.zh: 朝廷從其請。

translations.literal: Court approved their request.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved.

sentences.zh: 自是，廣南分東、西兩路。

translations.literal: From this, Guangnan divided East West two circuits.
translations.idiomatic: From then on Guangnan was divided into eastern and western circuits.

sentences.zh: 寶祐二年，監察御史陳大方言：「 士風日薄，文場多弊。

translations.literal: Baoyou second year, Investigating Censor Chen Dafang said: " Scholar custom daily thin, literary field many abuses.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Baoyou Investigating Censor Chen Dafang said, "Scholarly conduct grows daily weaker and the examination field has many abuses.

sentences.zh: 乞將發解士人初請舉者，從所司給帖赴省，別給一曆，如命官印紙之法，批書發解之年及本名年貫、保官姓名，執赴禮部，又批赴省之年，長貳印署。

translations.literal: Beg take send-up scholars first requesting recommendation, from their office issue slip go to metropolitan, separately issue one register, like appointed official stamped paper method, annotate send-up year and true name age native place guarantor names, carry to Ministry of Rites, again annotate year arriving at metropolitan, senior second officials seal sign.
translations.idiomatic: For scholars first seeking send-up, I ask that their office issue a slip for the metropolis and a separate register like appointed officials' stamped papers, annotating the send-up year, true name, age, native place, and guarantors; they should carry it to the Ministry of Rites and have the year of arrival at the metropolis annotated and sealed by senior officials.

sentences.zh: 赴監試者同。

translations.literal: Those attending supervision examination same.
translations.idiomatic: The same for those attending supervised examinations.

sentences.zh: 如將來免解、免省，到殿批書亦如之。

translations.literal: If in future exempt send-up exempt metropolitan, at palace annotate likewise.
translations.idiomatic: If later exempt from send-up or metropolitan examination, palace annotation should be the same.

sentences.zh: 如無曆則不收試。

translations.literal: If no register then not receive examination.
translations.idiomatic: Without a register they should not be examined.

sentences.zh: 候出官日赴吏部繳納，換給印紙。

translations.literal: Await day leaving office go Ministry of Personnel submit, exchange given stamped paper.
translations.idiomatic: Upon taking office they should submit it to the Ministry of Personnel and receive stamped papers.

sentences.zh: 應合免解、免省人，亦從先發解處照此給曆。

translations.literal: Those who should be exempt send-up exempt metropolitan, also from first send-up place follow this issue register.
translations.idiomatic: Those entitled to exempt send-up or metropolitan examination should also receive registers from their first send-up place on this model.

sentences.zh: 如省、殿中選，將元曆發下御史臺考察，以憑注闕給告。

translations.literal: If metropolitan palace selected, send original register down Censorate investigate, to rely on register vacancy issue notice.
translations.idiomatic: If selected at metropolitan or palace examination, the original register should be sent to the Censorate for investigation as basis for registering vacancies and issuing notices.

sentences.zh: 士子得曆，可為據證；

translations.literal: Scholars obtaining register, can serve as evidence;
translations.idiomatic: Scholars with registers would have evidence;

translations.literal: offices because register, can add investigation verification.
translations.idiomatic: and offices could investigate through the register.
