translations.idiomatic: Former false impersonators would withdraw of themselves."

sentences.zh: 遂自明年始行之。

translations.literal: Therefore from next year begin implement.
translations.idiomatic: This was implemented from the next year.

sentences.zh: 鄉貢、監補、省試皆有復試，然銓擇猶未精，其間濫名充貢者，不可欺同舉之人，冒選橋門者，不逃於本齋之職事。

translations.literal: Prefectural tribute, supervised supplement, metropolitan examination all have re-examination, yet selection still not refined, among them falsely named fill tribute, cannot deceive same-examination persons, false selection Rainbow Gate, not escape their dormitory duties.
translations.idiomatic: Prefectural tribute, supervised supplement, and metropolitan examination all had re-examination, yet selection was still imprecise: false names in tribute could not deceive fellow examinees, and false selection at the Rainbow Gate could not escape dormitory duties.

sentences.zh: 遂命今後本州審察，必責同舉之聯保，監學簾引，必責長諭之證實，並使結罪，方與放行。

translations.literal: Therefore ordered hereafter home prefecture investigate, must charge same-examination joint guarantee, supervised school curtain lead, must charge head instructor verification, all make penal oath, then permit release.
translations.idiomatic: Henceforth home prefectures must investigate, require joint guarantee from fellow examinees, require head instructors' verification for supervised school curtain leads, and require penal oaths before release.

sentences.zh: 中書復試，凡涉再引，非係雜犯，並先劄報各處漕司，每遇詔舉，必加稽驗。

translations.literal: Central Secretariat re-examination, whenever involving second summon, not miscellaneous offense, all first memorandum report each place transport commission, whenever encountering edict recruitment, must add investigation verification.
translations.idiomatic: For Central Secretariat re-examination, whenever a second summons was involved and it was not a miscellaneous offense, transport commissions were first notified by memorandum and every edict recruitment was to be investigated.

sentences.zh: 凡復試，令宰執出題，不許都司干預，仍日輪台諫一員，簾外監試。

translations.literal: Whenever re-examination, order chief ministers set questions, not permit chief secretariat intervene, still daily rotate censorate-remonstrance one member, outside curtain supervise examination.
translations.idiomatic: For re-examinations chief ministers were to set questions without chief secretariat intervention, and one censorate or remonstrance official daily was to supervise outside the curtain.

sentences.zh: 四年，命在朝之臣，除宰執、侍從、台諫外，自卿監、郎官以下至厘務官，各具三代宗支圖三本，結立罪狀，申尚書省、御史臺及禮部，所屬各置簿籍，存留照應。

translations.literal: Fourth year, ordered court ministers, except chief ministers attendants censorate-remonstrance, from directorate officials bureau officials down to clerical duty officials, each prepare three-generation clan branch charts three copies, establish penal oath, report Ministry of Personnel Censorate Ministry of Rites, subordinates each set registers, keep for reference.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year court officials except chief ministers, attendants, and censorate and remonstrance officials, from directorate officials and bureau officials down to clerical officers, were to prepare three copies of three-generation clan charts with penal oaths and report to the Ministry of Personnel, Censorate, and Ministry of Rites; each office was to keep registers for reference.

sentences.zh: 遇屬子孫登科、發解、入學、奏補事故，並具申入鑿。

translations.literal: When kin descendants pass degree, send-up, enter school, memorial supplement matters, all fully report enter register.
translations.idiomatic: When kin passed degrees, were sent up, entered schools, or received memorial supplements, all were to be reported and entered in the register.

sentences.zh: 後由外任登朝，亦於供職日後，具圖籍記如上法。

translations.literal: Later from outer appointment enter court, also on assuming office day after, prepare charts registers record as above method.
translations.idiomatic: Later those entering court from outer appointments were also to prepare charts and registers after assuming office by the same method.

sentences.zh: 遇胄試之年，照朝廷限員，於內牒能應舉人就試，以革胄牒冒濫之弊。

translations.literal: When collateral examination year, follow court limited numbers, within document able examinees examine, to reform collateral document false overflow abuse.
translations.idiomatic: In collateral-examination years, within court limits only those documented as able to examine might test, to reform false collateral documentation.

sentences.zh: 景定二年，胄子牒試員：宰執牒緦麻以上親增作四十人，侍從、台諫、給事中、舍人小功以上親增作二十七人，卿監、郎官、秘書省官、四總領小功以上親增作二十人，寺監丞簿、學官、二令大功以上親增作十五人，六院、四轄、省部門、史館校勘、檢閱大功以上親增作十人，臨安府通判牒大功以上親增作八人，餘應牒親子孫者，一仍舊制。

translations.literal: Jingding second year, collateral sons document examination numbers: chief ministers document three-months-mourning and above kin increased to forty persons, attendants censorate-remonstrance drafting attendants academicians lesser-merit and above kin increased to twenty-seven, directorate officials bureau officials Secretariat officials four commissioners lesser-merit and above kin increased to twenty, temple directorate assistants school officials two magistrates greater-merit and above kin increased to fifteen, six courts four jurisdictions ministry gates History Office collators reviewers greater-merit and above kin increased to ten, Lin'an Prefecture vice commissioner document greater-merit and above kin increased to eight, remainder should document kin descendants, all still old system.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Jingding, quotas for collateral sons in document examinations were set as follows: chief ministers' kin within three-months mourning and above increased to forty; palace attendants, censorate and remonstrance officials, supervising secretaries, and Secretariat drafters' kin within lesser merit mourning and above to twenty-seven; court and directorate officials, bureau directors, Secretariat officials, and the four commissioners' kin within lesser merit and above to twenty; temple and directorate assistants, school officials, and two magistrates' kin within greater merit and above to fifteen; six courts, four jurisdictions, ministry gates, and History Office collators and reviewers' kin within greater merit and above to ten; Lin'an vice prefects' kin within greater merit and above to eight; the remaining documented kin and descendants followed the old system.

sentences.zh: 度宗初，以雷同假手之弊，多由於州郡試院繼燭達旦，或至次日辰、巳猶未出院，其所以間日者，不惟止可以惠不能文之人，適足以害能文之士，遂一遵舊制，連試三日。

translations.literal: Duzong beginning, because identical proxy-hand abuses, mostly from prefecture examination compounds continuing candles until dawn, or reaching next day chen si still not leave compound, its reason alternate days, not only could benefit unable write persons, precisely enough harm able write scholars, therefore entirely follow old system, continuous examine three days.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Emperor Duzong's reign, identical-answer and proxy abuses arose largely because prefectural compounds burned candles until dawn or until chen or si the next day; alternate-day examination not only helped the unskilled but harmed the skilled, so the old system of three consecutive days was restored.

sentences.zh: 時諸州郡以鄉貢終場人眾而元額少，自咸淳九年為始，視終場人多寡，每二百人取放一名。

translations.literal: At that time various prefectures because prefectural tribute final session persons many yet original quota few, from Xianchun ninth year begin, view final session persons many few, each two hundred persons select release one.
translations.idiomatic: Because many completed prefectural tribute but quotas were small, from the ninth year of Xianchun one was selected per two hundred completing the final session.

sentences.zh: 以士子數多，增參詳官二員，點檢試卷官六員。

translations.literal: Because scholar count many, increased review officials two, inspection examination paper officials six.
translations.idiomatic: Because candidates were numerous, two review officials and six paper-inspection officials were added.

sentences.zh: 又以臣僚條上科場之弊，以大院別院參詳官、點檢試卷官兼考雷同，又監試兼專一詳定雷同試卷，不預考校。

translations.literal: Also because officials itemized examination ground abuses, great compound separate compound review officials inspection officials concurrently examine identical, also examination supervisor concurrently exclusively determine identical examination papers, not participate grading.
translations.idiomatic: Officials also itemized examination abuses: review and inspection officials in great and separate compounds were to check identical answers, and examination supervisors were exclusively to determine identical papers without grading.

sentences.zh: 遂罷簾外點檢雷同官，國子監解試雷同官亦罷。

translations.literal: Therefore abolished outside-curtain inspection identical officials, Imperial University send-up examination identical officials also abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Outside-curtain identical-answer inspection officials were abolished, as were those at the Imperial University send-up examination.

sentences.zh: 先是，州郡鄉貢未有復試。

translations.literal: Before this, prefecture prefectural tribute had no re-examination.
translations.idiomatic: Previously prefectural tribute had no re-examination.

sentences.zh: 會言者謂冒濫之弊，惟在鄉貢，遂命漕臣及帥守於解試揭曉之前，點差有出身倅貳或幕官專充復試。

translations.literal: Then memorialists said false overflow abuse, only in prefectural tribute, therefore ordered transport officials and commanders before send-up posting, designate assign those with origins deputies or staff officers exclusively fill re-examination.
translations.idiomatic: Memorialists said false overflow lay in prefectural tribute; transport officials and commanders were to assign deputies or staff with examination origins as re-examiners before the send-up list was posted.

sentences.zh: 盡一日命題考校，解名多者，斟酌分日。

translations.literal: Complete one day set questions examine grade, send-up names many, deliberate divide days.
translations.idiomatic: Questions were set and grading completed in one day, or divided over days where send-up names were many.

sentences.zh: 但能行文不繆、說理優通、覺非假手即取，非才不通就與駁放。

translations.literal: But able compose text not erroneous, explain principle excellent clear, feel not proxy-hand then select, not talented not pass then give strike dismiss.
translations.idiomatic: Those who could write without error, explain principles clearly, and were judged not to have used proxies were selected; the untalented were struck off.

sentences.zh: 如將來省復不通，罪及元復試漕守之臣及考校官。

translations.literal: If in future metropolitan re-examination not pass, punishment reaches original re-examination transport commander officials and grading officials.
translations.idiomatic: If they later failed metropolitan re-examination, the original re-examination transport officials, commanders, and graders were punished.

sentences.zh: 十年，省試，命大院、別院監試官於坐圖未定之先，親監分布坐次，嚴禁書鋪等人，不許縱容士子拋離座案，過越廊分，為傳義假手之地。

translations.literal: Tenth year, metropolitan examination, ordered great compound separate compound examination supervisors before seating chart unset beforehand, personally supervise distribute seating, strictly forbid book shops and others, not permit indulge scholars leave desks, cross corridors, as passing-answers proxy places.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year of metropolitan examination, supervisors of great and separate compounds were to oversee seating before charts were set, strictly forbid bookshops and others, and not permit scholars to leave desks or cross corridors for passing answers or proxies.

sentences.zh: 時成都已歸附我朝，殿試擬五月五日，以蜀士至者絕少，展至末旬。

translations.literal: At that time Chengdu already submitted to our dynasty, palace examination planned fifth month fifth day, because Shu scholars arriving extremely few, extended to last ten days.
translations.idiomatic: Chengdu had already submitted to the dynasty; the palace examination was planned for the fifth day of the fifth month but extended to the month's last ten days because few Shu scholars arrived.

sentences.zh: 又因復試特奏名至部猶少，展作六月七日。

translations.literal: Also because re-examination special listed candidates reaching ministry still few, extended to sixth month seventh day.
translations.idiomatic: Because few special listed candidates from re-examination reached the ministry, it was extended to the seventh day of the sixth month.

sentences.zh: 近臣以隆暑為請，復命立秋後擇日。

translations.literal: Close ministers because intense heat requested, again ordered after Start of Autumn choose day.
translations.idiomatic: Close ministers pleaded intense heat and it was again ordered for a day after Start of Autumn.

sentences.zh: 七月八日，度宗崩，竟不畢試。

translations.literal: Seventh month eighth day, Duzong died, ultimately not complete examination.
translations.idiomatic: On the eighth day of the seventh month Emperor Duzong died and the examination was never completed.

sentences.zh: 嗣君即位，下禮部討論，援引皆未當，既不可謂之亮陰，又不可不赴廷對，乃仿召試館職之制而行之。

translations.literal: Successor emperor enthroned, sent Ministry of Rites discuss, citations all not appropriate, since cannot call it bright mourning, also cannot not attend palace audience, therefore imitated summoned examination academy appointment system to implement.
translations.idiomatic: The successor enthroned and the Ministry of Rites was ordered to discuss; citations were all inappropriate—it could neither be called bright mourning nor could palace audience be skipped—so the system of summoned examination for academy appointments was imitated.

sentences.zh: 新進士舊有期集，渡江後置局於禮部貢院，特旨賜餐錢，唱第之三日赴焉。

translations.literal: New jinshi formerly had period gathering, after crossing Yangzi established bureau at Ministry of Rites tribute compound, special edict grant meal money, announce ranks third day go there.
translations.idiomatic: New jinshi formerly had a period gathering; after crossing the Yangzi a bureau was established at the Ministry of Rites tribute compound with special meal money; they went on the third day after ranks were announced.

sentences.zh: 上三人得自擇同升之彥，分職有差。

translations.literal: Top three persons could self-select same ascent talents, divided duties with differences.
translations.idiomatic: The top three might choose talented peers who rose with them and divide duties.

sentences.zh: 朝謝後拜黃甲，其儀設褥於堂上，東西相向，皆再拜。

translations.literal: After court thanks bow yellow class, its ritual set cushions on hall above, east west face each other, all twice bow.
translations.idiomatic: After court thanks they bowed to the yellow class; cushions were set in the hall east and west facing one another and all bowed twice.

sentences.zh: 拜已，擇榜中年長者一人，狀元拜之，復擇最少者一人拜狀元。

translations.literal: After bowing, select list among eldest one person, top graduate bow him, again select youngest one person bow top graduate.
translations.idiomatic: After bowing, the eldest on the list was chosen and the top graduate bowed to him; then the youngest was chosen to bow to the top graduate.

sentences.zh: 所以侈寵靈，重年好，明長少也。

translations.literal: Therefore expand favor spirit, emphasize age friendship, clarify elder younger.
translations.idiomatic: This displayed favor, honored age and friendship, and clarified senior and junior.

sentences.zh: 製舉無常科，所以待天下之才傑，天子每親策之。

translations.literal: Decree examination no fixed subject, therefore to await realm's outstanding talents, Son of Heaven each personally questions them.
translations.idiomatic: Decree examinations had no fixed subject and awaited outstanding talent; the emperor personally questioned candidates.

sentences.zh: 然宋之得才，多由進士，而以是科應詔者少。

translations.literal: Yet Song obtaining talent, mostly through jinshi, yet by this subject responding to edict few.
translations.idiomatic: Yet Song obtained talent mostly through jinshi; few responded to edict through this subject.

sentences.zh: 惟召試館職及後來博學宏詞，而得忠鯁文學之士。

translations.literal: Only summoned examination academy appointments and later erudite broad learning, obtained loyal upright literary scholars.
translations.idiomatic: Only summoned examination for academy appointments and later erudite broad learning produced loyal and literary men.

sentences.zh: 或起之山林，或取之朝著，召之州縣，多至大用焉。

translations.literal: Some raised from mountain forest, some taken from court dress, summoned from prefectures counties, many reached great employment.
translations.idiomatic: Some were raised from seclusion, some taken from court, summoned from prefectures and counties—many reached great employment.

sentences.zh: 太祖始置賢良方正能直言極諫、經學優深可為師法、詳閑吏理達於教化凡三科，不限前資，見任職官，黃衣草澤，悉許應詔，對策三千言，詞理俱優則中選。

translations.literal: Taizu first established worthy and good upright able direct speech extreme remonstrance, classic learning excellent deep can serve teacher model, detailed familiar official principles reaching education and transformation altogether three subjects, not limit prior qualification, current office holders, commoner grasslands, all permit respond edict, answer policy three thousand words, language principle both excellent then selected.
translations.idiomatic: Taizu first established three subjects: worthy and upright able to remonstrate directly, classic learning excellent and deep enough to serve as teacher, and detailed familiarity with official principles reaching education; without limit of prior qualification, current officials and commoners alike might respond; policy answers of three thousand words with excellent language and principle were selected.

sentences.zh: 乾德初，以郡縣亡應令者，慮有司舉賢之道或未至也，乃詔許士子詣闕自薦。

translations.literal: Qiande beginning, because prefectures counties none responded edict, feared offices recommend worthies way perhaps not reached, therefore edict permitted scholars go court self-recommend.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Qiande, because prefectures and counties had none responding to the edict, fearing offices had not fully reached the way of recommending worthies, scholars were permitted to go to court and recommend themselves.

sentences.zh: 四年，有司僅舉直言極諫一人，堪為師法一人，召陶穀等發策，帝親御殿臨視之，給硯席坐於殿之西隅。

translations.literal: Fourth year, offices only recommended direct speech extreme remonstrance one person, can serve teacher model one person, summoned Tao Gu and others issue questions, emperor personally attended hall oversee, gave inkstone mat seat at hall's west corner.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year offices recommended only one for direct remonstrance and one as teacher model; Tao Gu and others were summoned to issue questions; the emperor personally attended the hall and gave inkstone and mat in the west corner.

sentences.zh: 及對策，詞理疏闊，不應所問，賜酒饌宴勞而遣之。

translations.literal: When answering policy, language principle sparse broad, not respond what asked, bestowed wine food feast comfort and sent away.
translations.idiomatic: Their policy answers were sparse in language and principle and did not answer the questions; they were given wine and a feast and sent away.

sentences.zh: 開寶八年，詔諸州察民有孝弟力田、奇才異行或文武材幹、年二十至五十可任使者，具送闕下，如無人塞詔，亦以實聞。

translations.literal: Kaibao eighth year, edict all prefectures investigate people having filial piety brotherly respect diligent farming, outstanding talent unusual conduct or civil military ability, age twenty to fifty can serve envoys, fully send to court, if no persons block edict, also with truth report.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year of Kaibao prefectures were ordered to investigate people with filial piety, brotherly respect, diligent farming, outstanding talent, unusual conduct, or civil and military ability aged twenty to fifty fit for service, send them to court, and if none, report truthfully.

sentences.zh: 九年，諸道舉孝弟力田及有才武者凡七百四十人，詔翰林學士李昉等於禮部試其業，一無可采。

translations.literal: Ninth year, all circuits recommended filial piety brotherly respect diligent farming and those with talent martial altogether seven hundred forty persons, edict Hanlin academician Li Fang and others at Ministry of Rites test their achievement, altogether nothing selectable.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year circuits recommended seven hundred forty persons for filial piety, brotherly respect, diligent farming, or talent and martial skill; Hanlin academician Li Fang and others tested them at the Ministry of Rites and found nothing selectable.

sentences.zh: 而濮州以孝悌薦名者三百七十人，帝駭其多，召對講武殿，率不如詔。

translations.literal: Yet Puzhou with filial piety brotherly respect recommended names three hundred seventy persons, emperor alarmed its many, summoned audience Lecture Martial Hall, mostly not like edict.
translations.idiomatic: Puzhou alone recommended three hundred seventy for filial piety and brotherly respect; the emperor was alarmed and summoned them to the Lecture Martial Hall; most did not meet the edict.

sentences.zh: 猶自陳素習武事，復試以騎射，輒顛隕失次。

translations.literal: Still self-stated always practiced martial affairs, again tested with mounted archery, then topple fall lose order.
translations.idiomatic: They still claimed martial training; retested in mounted archery they toppled and lost order.

sentences.zh: 帝紿曰：「是宜隸兵籍。」

translations.literal: Emperor deceived said: "These should belong military register."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor feigned: "These should be entered in the military register."

sentences.zh: 皆號呼乞免，乃悉罷去。

translations.literal: All cried beg exemption, then all dismissed go.
translations.idiomatic: All cried begging exemption and were all dismissed.

sentences.zh: 詔劾本部濫舉之罪。

translations.literal: Edict impeach this circuit excessive recommendation crime.
translations.idiomatic: An edict impeached the circuit for excessive recommendation.

sentences.zh: 咸平四年，詔學士、兩省御史臺五品、尚書省諸司四品以上，於內外京朝幕府州縣官、草澤中，各舉賢良方正一人，不得以見任轉運使及館閣職事人應詔。

translations.literal: Xianping fourth year, edict academicians, two provinces Censorate fifth rank, Ministry of Personnel various offices fourth rank and above, from inner outer capital court staff prefecture county officials commoners, each recommend worthy upright one person, may not use incumbent transport commissioner and academy appointees respond edict.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Xianping, academicians, censorate officials of fifth rank, and Ministry of Personnel officials of fourth rank and above were ordered each to recommend one worthy and upright candidate from capital officials, prefectural officials, and commoners; incumbent transport commissioners and academy appointees might not respond to the edict.

sentences.zh: 是年，策秘書丞查道等七人，皆入第四等。

translations.literal: This year, questioned Secretariat Assistant Director Zha Dao and seven others, all entered fourth grade.
translations.idiomatic: That year Zha Dao and six other Secretariat assistant directors were examined; all placed in the fourth grade.

sentences.zh: 景德二年，增置博通墳典達於教化、才識兼茂明於體用、武足安邊、洞明韜略運籌決勝、軍謀宏遠材任邊寄等科，詔中書門下試察其才，具名聞奏，將臨軒親策之。

translations.literal: Jingde second year, added subjects penetrating classics reaching education, talent knowledge both rich clear in substance use, martial sufficient secure border, penetrating strategy deploy win, military planning vast talent border post, etc., edict Central Secretariat test observe their talent, prepare names report, will imperial hall personally question.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Jingde subjects were added for penetrating the classics and reaching education, combined talent clear in substance and use, martial skill to secure borders, penetrating strategy, and vast military planning for border posts; the Central Secretariat was to test their talent, report names, and the emperor would personally question them at the imperial hall.

sentences.zh: 自是應令者浸廣，而得中高等亦少。

translations.literal: From this those responding edict gradually broadened, yet obtaining middle high grades also few.
translations.idiomatic: From then on respondents to edicts gradually increased, but few attained middle or high grades.

sentences.zh: 太宗以來，凡特旨召試者，於中書學士舍人院，或特遣官專試，所試詩、賦、論、頌、策、制誥，或三篇，或一篇，中格則授以館職。

translations.literal: From Taizong onward, whenever special edict summoned examination, at Central Secretariat academician drafter courtyard, or specially dispatched official exclusive test, tested poetry rhapsody discourse eulogy policy edict, or three pieces or one piece, passing grade then grant academy appointment.
translations.idiomatic: From Taizong onward, special summons for examination were held at the Central Secretariat drafters' courtyard or by specially dispatched officials; candidates were tested in poetry, rhapsody, discourse, eulogy, policy, or edict—three pieces or one—and passing candidates received academy appointments.

sentences.zh: 景德後，惟將命為知制誥者，乃試制誥三道。

translations.literal: After Jingde, only those about to be appointed drafter of edicts, then tested three edict drafts.
translations.idiomatic: After Jingde only those to be appointed drafters of edicts were tested on three edict drafts.

sentences.zh: 〈（每道百五十字。）〉

translations.literal: (Each piece one hundred fifty characters.)
translations.idiomatic: (Each piece one hundred fifty characters.)

sentences.zh: 東封及祀汾陰時，獻文者多試業得官，蓋特恩也。

translations.literal: Eastern Fengshan and sacrifice at Fenyin times, those presenting writings many tested achievement obtained office, roughly special grace.
translations.idiomatic: At the Eastern Fengshan and Fenyin sacrifices many who presented writings passed tests and received office—special grace.

sentences.zh: 時言者以為：「兩漢舉賢良，多因兵荒災變，所以詢訪闕政。

translations.literal: At that time memorialists thought: "Two Han recommended worthy upright, mostly because military disaster famine calamity change, therefore inquire visit governmental lapses.
translations.idiomatic: Memorialists said, "In the two Han dynasties worthy and upright candidates were recommended mostly because of war, famine, and disasters, to inquire into governmental lapses.

sentences.zh: 今國家受瑞登封，無闕政也，安取此？」

translations.literal: Now the state receives auspicious signs and ascends Fengshan, no governmental lapses, why take this?"
translations.idiomatic: Now the state receives auspicious omens and performs Fengshan—there are no governmental lapses; why adopt this?"

sentences.zh: 乃罷其科，惟吏部設宏詞、拔萃、平判等科如舊制。

translations.literal: Therefore abolished its subject, only Ministry of Personnel established erudite words outstanding selection equal judgment subjects as old system.
translations.idiomatic: The subject was abolished; only the Ministry of Personnel's erudite words, outstanding selection, and equal judgment subjects remained as before.

sentences.zh: 仁宗初，詔曰：「朕開數路以詳延天下之士，而製舉獨久不設，意者吾豪傑或以故見遺也，其復置此科。」

translations.literal: Renzong beginning, edict said: "I open several paths to broadly extend realm's scholars, yet decree examination alone long not established, perhaps our heroes through this are overlooked, restore establish this subject."
translations.idiomatic: Early in Renzong's reign an edict said: "I have opened several paths to extend scholars throughout the realm, yet the decree examination alone has long been suspended—perhaps heroes are overlooked thereby; restore this subject."

sentences.zh: 於是增其名，曰：賢良方正能直言極諫科，博通墳典明於教化科，才識兼茂明於體用科，詳明吏理可使從政科，識洞韜略運籌帷幄科，軍謀宏遠材任邊寄科，凡六，以待京、朝之被舉及起應選者。

translations.literal: Therefore the names were increased, saying: the category of Worthy and Upright, Able to Speak Directly and Remonstrate to the Utmost; the category of Broadly Penetrating the Ancient Classics and Understanding Education and Transformation; the category of Combined Talent and Knowledge, Understanding Substance and Application; the category of Detailed Understanding of Administrative Principles and Fitness to Serve in Government; the category of Insight into Military Strategy and Planning Within the Curtains; and the category of Grand and Far-Reaching Military Planning, with Talent Fit for Border Responsibilities—six in all, to await those recommended from the capital and court and those who rose to answer selection.
translations.idiomatic: The names were therefore increased to six subjects: Worthy, Upright, and Able to Speak Directly and Remonstrate to the Utmost; Broadly Penetrating the Ancient Classics and Clear in Education and Transformation; Combined Talent and Knowledge, Clear in Substance and Application; Detailed and Clear in Administrative Principle and Able to Serve in Government; Insight into Strategy and Planning Within the Curtains; and Grand Military Planning with Talent for Border Trusts, for those recommended from the capital and court and those who rose to answer selection.

sentences.zh: 又置書判拔萃科，以待選人。

translations.literal: Also established document judgment outstanding selection subject, to await selection candidates.
translations.idiomatic: A document-judgment outstanding-selection subject was also established for selection candidates.

sentences.zh: 又置高蹈丘園科，沉淪草澤科，茂材異等科，以待布衣之被舉者。

translations.literal: Also established lofty in hills gardens subject, sunken in grasslands subject, outstanding talent exceptional grade subject, to await commoners recommended.
translations.idiomatic: Subjects were also established for recluses in hills and gardens, the sunken in grasslands, and outstanding talent of exceptional grade—for recommended commoners.

sentences.zh: 其法先上藝業於有司，有司較之，然後試秘閣，中格，然後天子親策之。

translations.literal: Its method first submit arts to offices, offices compare them, then test Secret Pavilion, pass grade, then Son of Heaven personally questions.
translations.idiomatic: The method required submitting work to offices for comparison, then examination at the Secret Pavilion, and if passing, personal questioning by the emperor.

sentences.zh: 治平三年，命宰執舉館職各五人。

translations.literal: Zhiping third year, ordered chief ministers recommend academy appointments each five persons.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Zhiping chief ministers were ordered each to recommend five persons for academy appointments.

sentences.zh: 先是，英宗謂中書曰：「水潦為災，言事者雲『咎在不能進賢』，何也？」

translations.literal: Before this, Yingzong told Central Secretariat: "Floods are disaster, memorialists say 'blame lies in not advancing worthies'—why?"
translations.idiomatic: Earlier Emperor Yingzong told the Central Secretariat, "Floods are a disaster and memorialists say the blame lies in not advancing worthies—why?"

sentences.zh: 歐陽脩曰：「近年進賢路狹，往時入館有三路，今塞其二矣。

translations.literal: Ouyang Xiu said: "In recent years the path of advancing worthies is narrow; formerly entering the academy had three paths, now two are blocked.
translations.idiomatic: Ouyang Xiu said, "In recent years the path for advancing worthies has narrowed; formerly there were three paths into the academy, and now two are blocked.

sentences.zh: 進士高科，一路也；

translations.literal: Jinshi high rank, one path;
translations.idiomatic: High-ranked jinshi—one path;

sentences.zh: 大臣薦舉，一路也；

translations.literal: great ministers' recommendation, one path;
translations.idiomatic: great ministers' recommendations—one path;

sentences.zh: 因差遣例除，一路也。

translations.literal: appointment by dispatch precedent, one path.
translations.idiomatic: appointment by dispatch precedent—one path.

sentences.zh: 往年進士五人以上皆得試，第一人及第不十年有至輔相者，今第一人兩任方得試，而第二人以下不復試，是高科路塞矣。

translations.literal: Formerly five or more jinshi all could be tested; first place within ten years some reached chief minister; now first place after two terms may test, second place and below no longer tested—the high-rank path is blocked.
translations.idiomatic: Formerly jinshi of fifth place or higher could all be tested and a top graduate might reach chief minister within ten years; now only the top graduate may test after two terms and those below second place are no longer tested—the high-rank path is blocked.

sentences.zh: 往時大臣薦舉即召試，今隻令上簿候缺人乃試，是薦舉路塞矣。

translations.literal: Formerly great ministers' recommendation meant immediate summoned test; now only register and wait for vacancy then test—the recommendation path is blocked.
translations.idiomatic: Formerly ministerial recommendation meant immediate summoned examination; now candidates only register and wait for a vacancy—the recommendation path is blocked.

sentences.zh: 惟有因差遣例除者，半是年勞老病之人。

translations.literal: Only those appointed by dispatch precedent are half aged in service, old and ill.
translations.idiomatic: Only appointees by dispatch precedent remain, and half are aged, old, or ill.

sentences.zh: 此臣所謂薦舉路狹也。」

translations.literal: This is what your subject calls the narrow recommendation path."
translations.idiomatic: This is what I mean by the narrow recommendation path."

sentences.zh: 帝納之，故有是命。

translations.literal: The emperor accepted it, therefore there was this order.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor accepted this, and therefore the order was issued.

sentences.zh: 韓琦、曾公亮、趙概等舉蔡延慶以下凡二十人，皆令召試，宰臣以人多難之。

translations.literal: Han Qi, Zeng Gongliang, Zhao Gai and others recommended Cai Yanqing and below altogether twenty persons, all ordered summoned test; chief ministers found the number difficult.
translations.idiomatic: Han Qi, Zeng Gongliang, Zhao Gai, and others recommended twenty persons including Cai Yanqing for summoned examination; chief ministers found the number troublesome.

sentences.zh: 帝曰：「既委公等舉之，苟賢，豈患多也？

translations.literal: The emperor said: "Since I entrusted you to recommend them, if worthy, why fear many?
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said, "Since I entrusted you to recommend them, if they are worthy, why fear their number?

sentences.zh: 先召試蔡延慶等十人，餘須後時。」

translations.literal: First summon test Cai Yanqing and ten others; the rest must wait."
translations.idiomatic: First summon Cai Yanqing and ten others for examination; the rest must wait."

sentences.zh: 神宗以進士試策，與製科無異，遂詔罷之。

translations.literal: Shenzong because jinshi policy examination resembled decree subjects, therefore edict abolished it.
translations.idiomatic: Because jinshi policy examinations resembled decree subjects, Shenzong ordered their abolition.

sentences.zh: 試館職則罷詩、賦，更以策、論。

translations.literal: Academy appointment tests abolished poetry and rhapsody, changed to policy and discourse.
translations.idiomatic: Academy tests abolished poetry and rhapsody and used policy questions and discourse instead.

sentences.zh: 元祐二年，復製科。

translations.literal: Yuanyou second year, restored decree subjects.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Yuanyou decree subjects were restored.

sentences.zh: 凡廷試前一年，舉奏官具所舉者策、論五十首奏上，而次年試論六首，禦試策一道，召試、除官、推恩略如舊制。

translations.literal: Whenever before palace examination one year, recommending officials prepare recommended persons' fifty policy discourses and submit; next year test six discourses, imperial test one policy, summoned test appointment favors roughly like old system.
translations.idiomatic: One year before the palace examination recommending officials submitted fifty policy discourses from each nominee; the next year six discourses were tested and one imperial policy question; summoned tests, appointments, and favors followed the old system.

sentences.zh: 右正言劉安世建言：「祖宗之待館職也，儲之英傑之地以飭其名節，觀以古今之書而開益其聰明，稍優其廩，不責以吏事，所以滋長德器，養成名卿賢相也。

translations.literal: Right Remonstrance Liu Anshi memorialized: "Ancestors treating academy appointments stored them in a place of outstanding talent to discipline their integrity, had them view ancient and modern books to open and benefit their intelligence, slightly favored their stipends, did not charge them with clerk duties—this was to grow virtue and vessels and nurture famous ministers and worthy chancellors.
translations.idiomatic: Right Remonstrance Liu Anshi proposed, "The ancestral emperors treated academy appointees by storing them in a place of outstanding talents to discipline their reputation and integrity, showing them books ancient and modern to open and sharpen their intelligence, slightly favoring their stipends, and not charging them with clerical affairs; this was how they nourished virtue and capacity and brought forth famous ministers and worthy chancellors.

sentences.zh: 近歲其選浸輕，或緣世賞，或以軍功，或酬聚斂之能，或徇權貴之薦。

translations.literal: In recent years its selection gradually lightened—some through hereditary reward, some through military merit, some repaying ability to gather wealth, some following powerful nobles' recommendation.
translations.idiomatic: Recently selection has grown lighter—through hereditary reward, military merit, repaying wealth-gathering, or powerful patrons' recommendations.

sentences.zh: 未嘗較試，遂獲貼職，多開幸門，恐非祖宗德意。

translations.literal: Never compared in test yet obtained attached appointment, opening many doors of favor—fearing this is not ancestors' virtuous intent.
translations.idiomatic: Many obtained attached appointments without examination, opening doors of favor—perhaps not the ancestors' intent.

sentences.zh: 望明詔執政，詳求文學行誼，審其果可長育，然後召試，非試毋得輒命，庶名器重而賢能進。」

translations.literal: Hope bright edict to chief ministers, carefully seek literary learning and conduct, examine whether they truly can be nurtured long, then summon test; without test may not rashly appoint—hoping office weight heavy and worthies advance."
translations.idiomatic: I hope the chief ministers will be clearly ordered to seek literary learning and conduct, confirm candidates can be nurtured, then summon them for examination; without examination they must not be appointed, so that office carries weight and worthies advance."

sentences.zh: 三年，乃詔：「大臣奏舉館職，並如舊召試、除授，惟朝廷特除，不用此令。」

translations.literal: Third year, then edict: "Great ministers memorial-recommend academy appointments, all as old summoned test appointment, only court special appointment not use this rule."
translations.idiomatic: In the third year an edict ordered: "great ministers' memorial recommendations for academy appointments follow the old summoned test and appointment; only special court appointments were excepted."

sentences.zh: 安世復奏曰：「祖宗時入館，鮮不由試。

translations.literal: Anshi again memorialized: "In ancestors' time entering academy, rarely not through test.
translations.idiomatic: Anshi memorialized again, "In ancestors' time entry to the academy rarely bypassed examination.

sentences.zh: 惟其望實素著，治狀顯白，或累持使節，或移鎮大藩，欲示優恩，方令貼職。

translations.literal: Only when reputation and substance were long established, governance achievements clear, or repeatedly held embassies or moved to great frontier posts, wishing to show favor, then ordered attached appointment.
translations.idiomatic: Only when reputation was established, achievements clear, or after repeated embassies or great frontier commands, to show favor, was attached appointment granted without test.

sentences.zh: 今既過聽臣言，追復舊制，又謂『朝廷特除，不在此限』。

translations.literal: Now having overheard my words, restored old system, yet also said 'court special appointment not within this limit.'
translations.idiomatic: Now having accepted my words and restored the old system, yet also saying 'court special appointments are not within this limit'—

sentences.zh: 則是人材高下，資曆深淺，但非奏舉，皆可直除，名為更張，弊源尚在。

translations.literal: then whether talent high or low, qualification deep or shallow, if not memorial recommendation all can be directly appointed—named reform yet source of abuse remains.
translations.idiomatic: then regardless of talent or qualification, anyone not memorial-recommended may be directly appointed—called reform yet the source of abuse remains.

sentences.zh: 願仿故事，資序及轉運使，方可以特命除授，庶塞僥幸，以重館職之選。」

translations.literal: Wish imitate precedent, qualification sequence and transport commissioner, then may special order appoint, hoping block opportunism and weight academy selection."
translations.idiomatic: I wish to imitate precedent: only at qualification of transport commissioner may special appointment be made, to block opportunism and weight academy selection."

sentences.zh: 紹聖初，哲宗謂：「製科試策，對時政得失，進士策亦可言。」

translations.literal: Shaosheng beginning, Zhezong said: "Decree subject policy tests address current affairs gains and losses; jinshi policy may also speak."
translations.idiomatic: Early in Shaosheng Zhezong said: "Decree subjects' policy tests address current affairs; jinshi policy answers may do the same."

sentences.zh: 因詔罷製科。

translations.literal: Therefore edict abolished decree subjects.
translations.idiomatic: An edict therefore abolished decree subjects.

sentences.zh: 既而三省言：「今進士純用經術。

translations.literal: Soon after Three Departments said: "Now jinshi purely use classic studies.
translations.idiomatic: Soon the Three Departments said, "Jinshi now use classic studies purely.

sentences.zh: 如詔誥、章表、箴銘、賦頌、赦敕、檄書、露布、誡諭，其文皆朝廷官守日用不可闕，且無以兼收文學博異之士。」

translations.literal: Such as edicts, memorials, admonitions, eulogies, rhapsodies, amnesties, proclamations, bulletins, warnings—their texts are all daily indispensable to court officials, and there is no way together to gather literary erudite outstanding scholars."
translations.idiomatic: Yet edicts, memorials, admonitions, eulogies, rhapsodies, amnesties, proclamations, bulletins, and warnings are daily indispensable to officials, and classic studies alone cannot gather literary and erudite talent together."

sentences.zh: 遂改置宏詞科，歲許進士及第者詣禮部請試，如見守官則受代乃請，率以春試上舍生附試，不自立院也。

translations.literal: Therefore changed to establish erudite words subject, yearly permit jinshi graduates go Ministry of Rites request test; if incumbent official then receive replacement then request, mostly spring test upper-hall students attached test, not self-establish courtyard.
translations.idiomatic: The erudite words subject was established; yearly jinshi graduates might request testing at the Ministry of Rites; incumbents requested after replacement; mostly upper-hall students tested in spring attached to the tribute compound.

sentences.zh: 試章表、露布、檄書用駢儷體，頌、箴銘、誡諭、序記用古體或駢儷，惟詔誥、赦敕不以為題。

translations.literal: Test memorials, bulletins, proclamations in parallel style; eulogies, admonitions, warnings, prefaces, records in ancient or parallel style; only edicts and amnesties not used as topics.
translations.idiomatic: Memorials, bulletins, and proclamations were tested in parallel style; eulogies, admonitions, warnings, prefaces, and records in ancient or parallel style; edicts and amnesties were not topics.

sentences.zh: 凡試二日四題，試者雖多，取毋過五人，中程則上之三省復試之，分上、中二等，推恩有差；

translations.literal: Whenever test two days four topics, examinees although many, select not exceed five persons, meeting standard then submit to Three Departments re-test, divide upper middle two grades, favors differ;
translations.idiomatic: Examinations lasted two days with four topics; however many candidates, no more than five were taken; those meeting standard were re-tested by the Three Departments in upper and middle grades with differing favors;

sentences.zh: 詞藝超異者，奏取旨命官。

translations.literal: literary skill exceptionally outstanding, memorial obtain imperial decision appoint office.
translations.idiomatic: the exceptionally outstanding were memorialized for imperial appointment.

sentences.zh: 大觀四年詔：「宏詞科格法未詳，不足以致文學之士，改立詞學兼茂科，歲附貢士院試，取毋過三人。」

translations.literal: Daguan fourth year edict: "Erudite words subject regulations not detailed, insufficient to obtain literary scholars, change establish erudite learning combined rich subject, yearly attached tribute scholar compound test, select not exceed three persons."
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Daguan an edict said: "the erudite words regulations were insufficient and the erudite learning combined with richness subject was established, tested yearly at the tribute compound with no more than three selected."

sentences.zh: 政和增為五人。

translations.literal: Zhenghe increased to five persons.
translations.idiomatic: Under Zhenghe it increased to five.

sentences.zh: 不試檄書，增制誥，以歷代史事借擬為之，中格則授館職。

translations.literal: Not test proclamations, added edict drafts, using historical dynasties' affairs borrowed simulation, passing grade then grant academy appointment.
translations.idiomatic: Proclamations were not tested; edict drafts were added using borrowed scenarios from historical dynasties; passing candidates received academy appointments.

sentences.zh: 宰臣執政親屬毋得試。

translations.literal: Chief ministers in power kin may not test.
translations.idiomatic: Kin of chief ministers in power might not test.

sentences.zh: 宣和罷試上舍，乃隨進士試於禮部。

translations.literal: Xuanhe abolished upper-hall test, then followed jinshi test at Ministry of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: Under Xuanhe upper-hall testing was abolished and candidates followed jinshi to test at the Ministry of Rites.

sentences.zh: 紹興元年，初復館職試，凡預召者，學士院試時務策一道，天子親覽焉。

translations.literal: Shaoxing first year, first restored academy appointment test; all pre-summoned, Hanlin Academy tests current affairs policy one question, Son of Heaven personally views.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Shaoxing academy tests were first restored; the summoned took one current-affairs policy question at the Hanlin Academy for the emperor's personal review.

sentences.zh: 然是時校書多不試，而正字或試或否。

translations.literal: Yet at that time collators often not tested, while rectifiers sometimes tested sometimes not.
translations.idiomatic: Yet collators often were not tested while rectifiers sometimes were and sometimes were not.

sentences.zh: 二年，詔舉賢良方正能直言極諫科，一遵舊制，自尚書兩省諫議大夫以上、御史中丞、學士、待制各舉一人。

translations.literal: Second year, edict recommend worthy upright able direct speech extreme remonstrance subject, entirely follow old system, from Ministry two provinces remonstrance grandees up, censor vice commissioner, academicians, awaiting draft each recommend one person.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year the worthy and upright able to remonstrate directly subject was issued an edict following the old system; from remonstrance grandees, vice censor, academicians, and awaiting draft appointees each recommended one person.

sentences.zh: 凡應詔者，先具所著策、論五十篇繳進，兩省侍從參考之，分為三等，次優以上，召赴秘閣，試論六首，於《九經》、《十七史》、《七書》、《國語》、《荀揚管子》、《文中子》內出題，學士兩省官考校，御史監之，四通以上為合格。

translations.literal: All responding edict first prepare written fifty policy discourses submit; two provinces attendants reference, divide three grades; next grade excellent and above, summon Secret Pavilion, test six discourses, from Nine Classics, Seventeen Histories, Seven Military Classics, Discourses, Xunzi, Yangzi, Guanzi, Wenzhongzi within set topics, academicians two-province officials examine, censors supervise, four passes and above qualified.
translations.idiomatic: Respondents first submitted fifty policy discourses; attendants graded them in three ranks; those of next grade excellent and above were summoned to the Secret Pavilion for six discourses drawn from the Nine Classics, Seventeen Histories, Seven Military Classics, Discourses, Xunzi, Yangzi, Guanzi, and Wenzhongzi, examined under censor supervision with four passes qualifying.

sentences.zh: 仍分五等，入四等以上者，天子親策之。

translations.literal: Still divide five grades; entering fourth grade and above, Son of Heaven personally questions.
translations.idiomatic: Five grades were used; fourth grade and above received personal questioning by the emperor.

sentences.zh: 第三等為上，恩數視廷試第一人，第四等為中，視廷試第三人，皆賜製科出身；

translations.literal: Third grade upper, favors like palace examination first person; fourth grade middle, like palace examination third person; all granted decree-subject origin;
translations.idiomatic: Third grade ranked highest with favors like the palace examination top graduate; fourth grade middle like the third graduate; all received decree-subject origin;

sentences.zh: 第五等為下，視廷試第四人，賜進士出身；

translations.literal: fifth grade lower, like palace examination fourth person, granted jinshi origin;
translations.idiomatic: fifth grade lowest like the fourth palace graduate, granted jinshi origin;

sentences.zh: 不入等者與簿尉差遣，已仕者則進官與升擢。

translations.literal: not entering grades with registrar and vice commissioner assignment; already in office then advance rank and promotion.
translations.idiomatic: those not graded received registrar and vice commissioner assignments; incumbents advanced in rank.

sentences.zh: 七年，以太陽有異。

translations.literal: Seventh year, because sun had anomaly.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year because the sun showed an anomaly,

sentences.zh: 令中外侍從各舉能直言極諫一人。

translations.literal: ordered inner and outer attendants each recommend one able direct speech extreme remonstrance.
translations.idiomatic: inner and outer attendants were each ordered to recommend one who could remonstrate directly.

sentences.zh: 是冬，呂祉舉選人胡銓，汪藻舉布衣劉度，即除銓樞密院編修官，而度不果召。

translations.literal: That winter, Lü Zhi recommended selection candidate Hu Quan, Wang Zao recommended commoner Liu Du; immediately appointed Quan Hanlin Academy compiler, while Du was not summoned.
translations.idiomatic: That winter Lü Zhi recommended Hu Quan and Wang Zao recommended Liu Du; Quan was appointed Hanlin compiler but Du was not summoned.

sentences.zh: 自是詔書數下，未有應者。

translations.literal: From this edicts repeatedly issued, yet none responded.
translations.idiomatic: Edicts were repeatedly issued thereafter, yet none responded.

sentences.zh: 孝宗乾道二年，苗昌言奏：「國初嘗立三科，真宗增至六科，仁宗時並許布衣應詔，於是名賢出焉。

translations.literal: Xiaozong Qiandao second year, Miao Changyan memorialized: "At founding three subjects were established, Zhenzong increased to six, Renzong also permitted commoners respond edict—then famous worthies emerged.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Qiandao under Xiaozong Miao Changyan said, "At the founding three subjects were established, Zhenzong increased them to six, and Renzong permitted commoners to respond—then famous worthies emerged.

sentences.zh: 請參稽前製，間歲下詔，權於正文出題，不得用僻書注疏，追復天聖十科，開廣薦揚之路，振起多士積年委靡之氣。」

translations.literal: Request consult precedents, every other year issue edict, temporarily from main text set topics, may not use obscure books commentaries, restore Tiansheng ten subjects, open broad recommendation paths, rouse many scholars' years of listless spirit."
translations.idiomatic: He asked to consult precedents, issue edicts every other year, set topics from main texts without obscure commentaries, restore Tiansheng's ten subjects, open recommendation paths, and rouse scholars' long listlessness."

sentences.zh: 遂詔禮部集館職、學官雜議，皆曰：「 注疏誠可略，科目不必廣。

translations.literal: Therefore edict Ministry of Rites gather academy appointees school officials discuss, all said: "Commentaries truly may be abbreviated, subjects need not be broad.
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry of Rites gathered academy and school officials to discuss; all said "commentaries might be abbreviated and subjects need not be broad.

sentences.zh: 天下之士，屏處山林，滯跡遐遠，侍從之臣，豈能盡知。」

translations.literal: Realm's scholars hide in mountain forests, linger in distant places—attendant ministers how can all know."
translations.idiomatic: Scholars hide in mountains and distant places—how can attendants know them all?"

sentences.zh: 遂如國初之制，止令監司、守臣解送。

translations.literal: Therefore like founding system, only ordered supervisory commissioners and prefects send up.
translations.idiomatic: As at the founding, only supervisory commissioners and prefects were to send candidates up.

sentences.zh: 七年，詔舉製科以六論，增至五通為合格，始命官、糊名、謄錄如故事。

translations.literal: Seventh year, edict recommend decree subjects with six discourses, increased to five passes qualified, first ordered officials, sealed names, transcription as precedent.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year decree subjects used six discourses with five passes qualifying; officials, sealed names, and transcription followed precedent.

sentences.zh: 試院言：「文卷多不知題目所出，有僅及二通者。」

translations.literal: Examination compound said: "Essay rolls many did not know topics' source, some only reached two passes."
translations.idiomatic: The compound reported "many did not know topic sources and some reached only two passes."

sentences.zh: 帝命賜束帛罷之，舉官皆放罪。

translations.literal: Emperor ordered grant silk and dismiss; recommending officials all punished.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered silk given and dismissal; recommending officials were all punished.

sentences.zh: 舊試六題，一明一暗。

translations.literal: Old test six questions, one clear one hidden.
translations.idiomatic: Formerly six questions were tested, one clear and one hidden.

sentences.zh: 時考官命題多暗僻，失求言之意，臣僚請遵天聖、元祐故事，以經題為第一篇，然後雜出《九經》、《語》、《孟》內注疏或子史正文，以見尊經之意。

translations.literal: At that time examiners' topics many hidden obscure, lost seeking words' intent; officials requested follow Tian Sheng Yuanyou precedent, use classic topic as first, then mix from Nine Classics, Discourses, Mencius commentaries or histories' main text, to show honoring classics.
translations.idiomatic: Examiners' topics were often obscure, losing the intent of seeking words; officials asked to follow Tian Sheng and Yuanyou precedent with a classic as first question then mix from classics, Analects, Mencius, commentaries, or histories to honor the classics.

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: Approved.
translations.idiomatic: Approved.

sentences.zh: 初，製科取士必以三年，十一年，詔：「自今有合召試者，舉官即以名聞。」

translations.literal: Initially decree subjects took scholars necessarily every three years; eleventh year edict: "From now when fit for summoned test, recommending official immediately report name."
translations.idiomatic: Initially decree subjects were triennial; in the eleventh year an edict said: "when fit for summoned test the recommender should immediately report the name."

sentences.zh: 明年春，李巘言：「賢良之舉，本求讜言以裨闕政，未聞責以記誦之學，使才行學識如晁、董之倫，雖注疏未能盡記，於治道何損？」

translations.literal: Next spring Li Yan said: "Worthy upright recommendation originally seeks candid words to supplement governmental lapses; not heard to charge memorization learning—if talent learning knowledge like Chao, Dong, though commentaries not fully memorized, what harm to governance?"
translations.idiomatic: Next spring Li Yan said "worthy upright recommendation seeks candid words for government, not memorization—if talent like Chao or Dong lacked full memorization of commentaries, what harm to governance?"

sentences.zh: 帝以為然，乃復罷注疏。

translations.literal: Emperor thought so, then again abolished commentaries.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor agreed and commentaries were again abolished.

sentences.zh: 高宗立博學宏詞科，凡十二通，制誥、詔表、露布、檄、箴銘、記讚、頌序內雜出六題，分為三場，每場體製一古一今。

translations.literal: Gaozong established erudite broad learning subject, altogether twelve passes, edicts memorials bulletins proclamations admonitions records eulogies prefaces within mixed six topics, divided three sessions, each session one ancient one modern form.
translations.idiomatic: Gaozong established erudite broad learning: twelve passes with six mixed topics among edicts, memorials, bulletins, proclamations, admonitions, records, eulogies, and prefaces in three sessions of ancient and modern forms.

sentences.zh: 遇科場年，應命官除歸明、流外、入貲及犯贓人外，公卿子弟之秀者皆得試。

translations.literal: When examination year, except ordered officials except returned bright, flow outside, purchased office and corruption excepted, excellent sons of dukes and ministers all could test.
translations.idiomatic: In examination years, except ordered officials, returned bright, flow outside, purchased office, and the corrupt, excellent sons of dukes and ministers might test.

sentences.zh: 先投所業三卷，學士院考之，拔其尤者召試，定為三等。

translations.literal: First submit three scrolls of work, Hanlin Academy examines, select best for summoned test, fix three grades.
translations.idiomatic: Three scrolls were submitted first; the Hanlin Academy examined and summoned the best in three grades.

sentences.zh: 上等轉一官，選人改秩，無出身人賜進士及第，並免召試，除館職。

translations.literal: Upper grade transfer one rank, selection candidate change rank, no-origin granted jinshi passed degree, all exempt summoned test, grant academy appointment.
translations.idiomatic: Upper grade gained one rank, selection candidates changed rank, those without origin received jinshi with honors, all exempted summoned test and received academy appointments.

sentences.zh: 中等減三年磨勘，與堂除，無出身人賜進士出身；

translations.literal: Middle grade reduce three years merit review, with hall appointment; no origin granted jinshi origin;
translations.idiomatic: Middle grade reduced three years merit review with hall appointment; without origin granted jinshi origin;

sentences.zh: 下等減二年磨勘，無出身人賜同進士出身：並許召試館職。

translations.literal: lower grade reduce two years merit review; no origin granted fellow jinshi origin: all permitted summoned academy test.
translations.idiomatic: lower grade reduced two years; without origin granted fellow jinshi origin—all might take summoned academy test.

sentences.zh: 南渡以來所得之士，多至卿相、翰苑者。

translations.literal: Since crossing south, obtained scholars mostly reached chief ministers and Hanlin.
translations.idiomatic: Since the southward crossing many who passed reached chief ministers and Hanlin.

sentences.zh: 理宗嘉熙三年，臣僚奏：「詞科實代王言，久不取人，日就廢弛。

translations.literal: Lizong Jiaxi third year, officials memorialized: "Words subject truly substitutes royal words, long not selecting people, daily approaches abolition.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Jiaxi under Lizong officials said: "The words subject substitutes for royal words but long went without selections and daily neared abolition.

sentences.zh: 蓋試之太嚴，故習之者少。

translations.literal: Because testing too strict, therefore practitioners few.
translations.idiomatic: Testing was too strict so few practiced.

sentences.zh: 今欲除博學宏詞科從舊三歲一試外，更降等立科。

translations.literal: Now wish besides erudite broad learning triennial test, further lower grade establish subject.
translations.idiomatic: Besides triennial erudite broad learning they wished to establish a lower subject.

sentences.zh: 止試文辭，不貴記問。

translations.literal: Only test literary skill, not value memorization.
translations.idiomatic: Only literary skill would be tested, not memorization.

sentences.zh: 命題止分兩場，引試須有出身人就禮部投狀，獻所業，如試教官例。

translations.literal: Set topics only two sessions, summon test must have origin person submit petition to Ministry of Rites, present work like test school official precedent.
translations.idiomatic: Two sessions only; candidates with origin submitted petitions and work to the Ministry of Rites like school-official tests.

sentences.zh: 每一歲附銓闈引試，惟取合格，不必拘額，中選者與堂除教授，已係教官資序及京官不願就教授者，京官減磨勘，選人循一資。

translations.literal: Each year attached to selection compound summon test, only take qualified, need not fix quota; selected with hall appointment professor, already school official qualification and capital officials unwilling professor—capital officials reduce merit review, selection candidates advance one qualification.
translations.idiomatic: Yearly attached to the selection compound without fixed quota; selected received hall professor appointments; capital officials reduced merit review and selection candidates advanced one rank.

sentences.zh: 他時北門、西掖、南宮舍人之任，則擇文墨超卓者用之。

translations.literal: Later north gate, west assistant, south palace drafter posts then select outstanding literary talent.
translations.idiomatic: Later north gate, west assistant, and south palace drafter posts would select outstanding literary talent.

sentences.zh: 其科目，則去『宏博』二字，止稱詞學科。」

translations.literal: Its subject then remove 'broad erudite' two characters, only called words learning subject."
translations.idiomatic: The subject dropped 'broad erudite' and was only called words learning subject."

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: Approved.
translations.idiomatic: Approved.

sentences.zh: 淳祐初，罷。

translations.literal: Chunyou beginning, abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Chunyou it was abolished.

sentences.zh: 景定二年，復嘉熙之制。

translations.literal: Jingding second year, restored Jiaxi system.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Jingding the Jiaxi system was restored.

sentences.zh: 初，內外學官多朝廷特注，後稍令國子監取其舊試藝等格優者用之。

translations.literal: Initially inner and outer school officials mostly court special appointment; later gradually ordered Imperial University take old test arts equal grade excellent to use.
translations.idiomatic: Initially school officials inside and out were mostly special court appointments; later the Imperial University gradually selected those excellent in old test arts.

sentences.zh: 熙寧八年，始立教授試法，即舍人院召試大義五道。

translations.literal: Xining eighth year, first established professor test method, namely drafter courtyard summoned test great meaning five questions.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year of Xining professor testing was first established: the drafters' courtyard summoned candidates for five questions on great meaning.

sentences.zh: 元豐七年，令諸州無教官，則長吏選在任官上其名，而監學審其可者使兼之。

translations.literal: Yuanfeng seventh year, ordered prefectures without instructors then chief administrator select incumbent official submit name, supervising school examine suitable to make concurrent.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year of Yuanfeng prefectures without instructors had chiefs select incumbents and the supervising school approved concurrent service.

sentences.zh: 元祐中，罷試法，已而論薦益眾，乃詔須命舉乃得奏。

translations.literal: Yuanyou middle, abolished test method; soon discussion recommendations increased, then edict must ordered recommendation then may memorial.
translations.idiomatic: In Yuanyou testing was abolished; as recommendations increased, ordered recommendation was required before memorial.

sentences.zh: 紹聖初，三省立格，中制科及進士甲第、禮部奏名在上三人、府監廣文館第一人、從太學上舍得第，皆不待試，餘召試兩經大義各一道，合格則授教官。

translations.literal: Shaosheng beginning, Three Departments established regulations: passing decree subjects and jinshi first class, Ministry listed top three, prefecture directorate Guangwen first, Imperial University upper hall passed degree—all without awaiting test; remainder summoned test two classics great meaning each one question, qualified then grant instructor.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Shaosheng the Three Departments ruled decree subjects, jinshi first class, Ministry top three, prefectural Guangwen first, and upper-hall graduates need not test; others took two classics great-meaning questions to become instructors.

sentences.zh: 元符中，增試三經。

translations.literal: Yuanfu middle, increased test three classics.
translations.idiomatic: In Yuanfu three classics were added to the test.

sentences.zh: 政和二年，臣僚言：「元豐召試學官六十人，而所取四人，皆知名之士，故學者厭服。

translations.literal: Zhenghe second year, officials said: "Yuanfeng summoned test school officials sixty persons, yet took four, all famous scholars, therefore learners submitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Zhenghe officials said: "Yuanfeng tested sixty school officials but took four famous scholars, so learners submitted.

sentences.zh: 近試率三人取一，今欲十人始取一人，以重其選。」

translations.literal: Recent tests mostly three take one; now wish ten begin take one, to weight selection."
translations.idiomatic: Recently one in three passed; they wished one in ten to weight selection."

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: Approved.
translations.idiomatic: Approved.

sentences.zh: 自是或如舊法，中書選注。

translations.literal: From this sometimes like old method, Central Secretariat select appoint.
translations.idiomatic: Sometimes the old method returned and the Central Secretariat appointed.

sentences.zh: 又嘗員外添置八行應格人為大藩教官，不以蒞職，隨廢。

translations.literal: Also once extra added eight conduct qualified persons as great prefecture instructors, not assuming office, soon abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Eight-conduct qualifiers were once added as great-prefecture instructors without taking office, soon abolished.

sentences.zh: 或用元豐試法，更革無常。

translations.literal: Or used Yuanfeng test method, reforms without constancy.
translations.idiomatic: Or Yuanfeng testing was used—reforms were inconstant.

sentences.zh: 高宗初年，復教官試。

translations.literal: Gaozong early years, restored instructor test.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Gaozong's reign instructor testing was restored.

sentences.zh: 紹興中，議者謂：「欲為人師，而自獻以求進，非禮也。」

translations.literal: Shaoxing middle, discussants said: "Wishing to be others' teacher yet self-presenting to advance is not ritual."
translations.idiomatic: In Shaoxing discussants said "wishing to teach others yet presenting oneself to advance was not ritual."

sentences.zh: 乃罷試而自朝廷選差。

translations.literal: Therefore abolished test and from court select assign.
translations.idiomatic: Testing was abolished and the court selected appointees.

sentences.zh: 已而又復之，凡有出身者許應，先具經義、詩、賦各三首赴禮部，乃下省闈，分兩場試之。

translations.literal: Soon restored; all with origin permitted respond, first prepare classic elucidation poetry rhapsody each three to Ministry of Rites, then lower provincial gate, divide two sessions test.
translations.idiomatic: Soon restored: those with origin submitted three classic elucidation, poetry, and rhapsody pieces to the Ministry of Rites, then tested in two sessions at the provincial gate.

sentences.zh: 初任為諸州教官，由是為兩學之選。

translations.literal: First appointment prefecture instructors, from this became two schools' selection.
translations.idiomatic: First appointments were prefectural instructors—the path into both schools.

sentences.zh: 十五年，從國子監丞文浩所言，於《六經》中取二經，各出兩題，毋拘義式，以貫穿該贍為合格。

translations.literal: Fifteenth year, following Imperial University aide Wen Hao, from Six Classics take two classics, each set two topics, not bound to meaning form, penetrating comprehensive as qualified.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year following Wen Hao, two classics were chosen from the six with two topics each without formula; comprehensive penetration qualified.

sentences.zh: 其後，四川製置司遇類省試年，亦仿禮部附試，自嘉泰元年始。

translations.literal: Later Sichuan Pacification Commission when classified metropolitan year also imitated Ministry attached test, from Jiatai first year.
translations.idiomatic: Later in classified metropolitan years Sichuan also attached tests like the Ministry, from Jiatai first year.

sentences.zh: 凡童子十五歲以下，能通經作詩賦，州升諸朝，而天子親試之。

translations.literal: Whenever youths fifteen and below able penetrate classics compose poetry rhapsody, prefecture sends up to court, Son of Heaven personally tests.
translations.idiomatic: Youths fifteen and under who mastered classics and composed poetry and rhapsody were sent up by prefectures for the emperor's personal test.

sentences.zh: 其命官、免舉無常格。

translations.literal: Their appoint office, exempt recommendation without fixed rule.
translations.idiomatic: Appointment and exemption from recommendation had no fixed rule.

sentences.zh: 真宗景德二年，撫州晏殊、大名府薑蓋始以童子召試詩賦，賜殊進士出身，蓋同學究出身。

translations.literal: Zhenzong Jingde second year, Fuzhou Yan Shu, Daming Fu Jiang Gai first as youths summoned test poetry rhapsody; granted Shu jinshi origin, Gai same student-research origin.
translations.idiomatic: In Jingde second year of Zhenzong Yan Shu of Fuzhou and Jiang Gai of Daming were first youths summoned for poetry and rhapsody; Shu received jinshi origin and Gai student-research origin.

sentences.zh: 尋復召殊試賦、論，帝嘉其敏贍，授秘書正字。

translations.literal: Soon again summoned Shu test rhapsody discourse; emperor praised his quick abundance, appointed Secretariat rectifier.
translations.idiomatic: Shu was soon summoned again; the emperor praised his quick talent and appointed him Secretariat rectifier.

sentences.zh: 後或罷或復。

translations.literal: Later sometimes abolished sometimes restored.
translations.idiomatic: Later it was sometimes abolished and sometimes restored.

sentences.zh: 自仁宗即位，至大觀末，賜出身者僅二十人。

translations.literal: From Renzong enthronement to Daguan end, granted origin only about twenty persons.
translations.idiomatic: From Renzong's enthronement to Daguan's end only about twenty received origin.

sentences.zh: 建炎二年，明舊制，親試童子，召見朱虎臣，授官賜金帶以寵之。

translations.literal: Jianyan second year, clarified old system, personally test youths, summoned audience Zhu Huchen, granted office bestowed gold belt to favor.
translations.idiomatic: In Jianyan second year the old system was clarified; Zhu Huchen was summoned, granted office and a gold belt.

sentences.zh: 後至者或誦經、史、子、集，或誦御製詩文，或誦兵書、習步射，其命官、免舉，皆臨期取旨，無常格。

translations.literal: Later arrivals sometimes recited classics histories masters collections, sometimes imperial compositions, sometimes military books practiced foot archery; appoint office exempt recommendation all took imperial decision at term, no fixed rule.
translations.idiomatic: Later arrivals recited classics, histories, imperial writings, or military books and archery; appointments followed temporary imperial decisions.

sentences.zh: 淳熙中，王克勤始以程文求試。

translations.literal: Chunxi middle, Wang Keqin first sought test with examination essays.
translations.idiomatic: In Chunxi Wang Keqin first sought testing with examination essays.

sentences.zh: 內殿引見，孝宗嘉其警敏，補從事郎，令秘閣讀書。

translations.literal: Inner palace audience; Xiaozong praised his alert quickness, supplemented Attendant Gentleman, ordered Secret Pavilion reading.
translations.idiomatic: At inner audience Xiaozong praised his alertness, made him Attendant Gentleman, and ordered Secret Pavilion study.

sentences.zh: 會禮部言：「本朝童子以文稱者，楊億、宋綬、晏殊、李淑，後皆為賢宰相、名侍從。

translations.literal: Then Ministry of Rites said: "This dynasty youths famous in letters—Yang Yi, Song Shou, Yan Shu, Li Shu—later all became worthy chancellors and famous attendants.
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry of Rites said "youths famous for letters—Yang Yi, Song Shou, Yan Shu, Li Shu—later became chancellors and famous attendants.

sentences.zh: 今郡國舉貢，問其所能，不過記誦，宜稍艱其選。」

translations.literal: Now prefectures recommend tribute, asking their ability, nothing beyond memorization—should slightly harden selection."
translations.idiomatic: Now prefectures recommend only memorization—selection should be hardened."

sentences.zh: 八年，始分為三等：凡全誦《六經》、《孝經》、《語》、《孟》及能文，如《六經》義三道、《語》《孟》義各一道、或賦一道、詩一首為上等，與推恩；

translations.literal: Eighth year, first divided three grades: all recite Six Classics, Filial Classic, Analects, Mencius and able write, such as Six Classics meaning three questions, Analects Mencius meaning each one, or one rhapsody one poem as upper grade, with favors;
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year three grades were fixed: full recitation of Six Classics, Filial Classic, Analects, and Mencius plus writing—with classic meaning questions, Analects and Mencius meanings, or rhapsody and poem as upper grade with favors;

sentences.zh: 誦書外能通一經，為中等，免文解兩次；

translations.literal: besides recitation able penetrate one classic, middle grade, exempt document send-up twice;
translations.idiomatic: recitation plus one classic penetrated was middle grade, exempting twice from document send-up;

sentences.zh: 止能誦《六經》、《語》、《孟》為下等，免文解一次。

translations.literal: only able recite Six Classics, Analects, Mencius lower grade, exempt document send-up once.
translations.idiomatic: only full recitation of Six Classics, Analects, and Mencius was lower grade, exempting once.

sentences.zh: 覆試不合格者，與賜帛。

translations.literal: Re-test not qualified, grant silk.
translations.idiomatic: Those failing re-test received silk.

sentences.zh: 寧宗嘉定十四年，命歲取三人，期以季春集闕下。

translations.literal: Ningzong Jiading fourteenth year, ordered yearly take three persons, expect late spring gather at capital.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiading fourteenth year of Ningzong three were taken yearly to gather at the capital in late spring.

sentences.zh: 先試於國子監，而中書復試之，為永製焉。

translations.literal: First test Imperial University, Central Secretariat re-tests, as permanent system.
translations.idiomatic: First at the Imperial University, then Central Secretariat re-test—as permanent system.

sentences.zh: 理宗後罷此科，須卓絕能文者，許諸郡薦舉。

translations.literal: Lizong later abolished this subject; only exceptionally literary permitted prefectural recommendation.
translations.idiomatic: Lizong later abolished this subject; only the exceptionally literary might be recommended.

sentences.zh: 科目既設，猶慮不能盡致天下之才，或韜晦而不屑就也，往往命州郡搜羅，而公卿得以薦言。

translations.literal: Subjects since established, still feared not fully reaching realm's talent, some hidden and disdaining to come, often ordered prefectures search, and dukes and ministers might recommend.
translations.idiomatic: Though subjects were established, the court still feared not reaching all talent; prefectures were ordered to search and ministers might recommend the hidden.

sentences.zh: 若治平之黃君俞，熙寧之王安國，元豐則程頤，元祐則陳師道，元符則徐積，皆卓然較著者也。

translations.literal: Such as Zhiping's Huang Junyu, Xining's Wang Anguo, Yuanfeng Cheng Yi, Yuanyou Chen Shidao, Yuanfu Xu Ji—all outstanding and notable.
translations.idiomatic: Such as Huang Junyu in Zhiping, Wang Anguo in Xining, Cheng Yi in Yuanfeng, Chen Shidao in Yuanyou, and Xu Ji in Yuanfu—all outstanding.

sentences.zh: 熙寧三年，諸路搜訪行義為鄉里推重者，凡二十有九人。

translations.literal: Xining third year, circuits searched conduct esteemed in villages, altogether twenty-nine persons.
translations.idiomatic: In Xining third year circuits searched for village-esteemed conduct—twenty-nine persons.

sentences.zh: 至，則館之太學，而劉蒙以下二十二人試舍人院，賜官有差，亦足以見幽隱必達，治世之盛也。

translations.literal: When arrived, housed in Imperial University; Liu Meng and twenty-two below tested drafter courtyard, granted office with differences—also enough to see hidden must reach, flourishing age's abundance.
translations.idiomatic: They were housed in the Imperial University; Liu Meng and twenty-two others tested at the drafters' courtyard with differing grants—showing hidden talent reached in a flourishing age.

sentences.zh: 其後，應詔者多失實，而朝廷亦厭薄之。

translations.literal: Later respondents to edict mostly lacked substance, and court also grew weary and slighted it.
translations.idiomatic: Later edict respondents mostly lacked substance and the court grew weary.

sentences.zh: 高宗垂意遺逸，首召布衣譙定，而尹焞以處士入講筵。

translations.literal: Gaozong attended to unattached worthies, first summoned commoner Qiao Ding, while Yin Tun entered lecture seat as recluse.
translations.idiomatic: Gaozong attended to unattached worthies, first summoning Qiao Ding while Yin Tun entered the lecture seat as recluse.

sentences.zh: 其後束帛之聘，若王忠民之忠節，張誌行之高尚，劉勉之、胡憲之力學，則賜出身，俾教授本郡，或賜處士號以寵之。

translations.literal: Later silk appointments such as Wang Zhongmin's loyal integrity, Zhang Zhixing's loftiness, Liu Mianzhi and Hu Xian's diligent learning—granted origin, made instruct home prefecture, or granted recluse title to favor.
translations.idiomatic: Later silk appointments honored Wang Zhongmin's loyalty, Zhang Zhixing's loftiness, and Liu Mianzhi and Hu Xian's learning—with origin, home instruction, or recluse titles.

sentences.zh: 所以振清節，厲頹俗。

translations.literal: Therefore to rouse pure integrity, encourage decadent custom.
translations.idiomatic: This roused pure integrity and encouraged a decadent age.

sentences.zh: 如徐庭筠之不出，蘇雲卿之晦跡，世尤稱焉。

translations.literal: Such as Xu Tingyun's not coming forth, Su Yunqing's hidden traces—the age especially praised.
translations.idiomatic: Such as Xu Tingyun not coming forth and Su Yunqing's hidden traces—the age especially praised them.

sentences.zh: 寧宗慶元間，蔡元定以高明之資，講明一代正學，以尤袤、楊萬里之薦召之，固以疾辭，竟以偽學貶死，眾咸惜之。

translations.literal: Ningzong Qingyuan period, Cai Yuanding with lofty bright talent, elucidated one generation's correct learning, through You Mao Yang Wanli's recommendation summoned him, firmly with illness declined, ultimately because false learning demoted died, crowd all regretted.
translations.idiomatic: In the Qingyuan era under Ningzong, Cai Yuanding of lofty talent elucidated the correct learning of the age; summoned on recommendation by You Mao and Yang Wanli, he firmly declined on grounds of illness, yet was ultimately demoted and died in the false-learning purge—all regretted it.

sentences.zh: 理、度以後，國勢日迫，賢者肥遁，迄無聞焉。

translations.literal: Li Duzong after, state situation daily pressing, worthies plump escape, to end no report.
translations.idiomatic: After Lizong and Duzong the state's situation daily grew desperate; worthies withdrew in seclusion and were heard of no more.
